sentences.zh: 你好，我叫萨曼莎·夏皮罗，是《纽约

sentences.en: I wrote a story in this week's issue about homeless students in the New York
sentences.zh: 我在本周的杂志中写了一篇关于纽约

sentences.en: City public school system.
sentences.zh: 市公立学校系统中无家可归学生的故事。

sentences.en: I got interested in this story when my son was in kindergarten at our local public school and his best friend became homeless.
sentences.zh: 我开始关注这个故事，是因为我儿子在我们当地公立学校上幼儿园时，他最好的朋友变得无家可归了。

sentences.en: His family was evicted from their apartment and then went through a long process of trying to use a housing voucher that
sentences.zh: 他的家人被赶出了公寓，随后经历了一个漫长的过程：试图使用城市提供的住房券

sentences.en: the city provided to find another rental, of trying to appeal the eviction, of doing anything
sentences.zh: 来寻找另一处出租房，试图对驱逐令提出上诉，尽一切

sentences.en: they could to try to stay in the community where they were known and loved and had a lot of resources.
sentences.zh: 努力留在他们熟悉、热爱且拥有丰富资源的社区。

sentences.en: And that process really opened my eyes first to the fact that the majority of homeless people in
sentences.zh: 那个过程让我大开眼界，首先让我意识到，纽约市

sentences.en: New York City are not the people that you see on the street or in the subway.
sentences.zh: 大多数无家可归的人并不是你在街头或地铁里看到的那样。

sentences.en: And they don't look any different than other families who are out and about.
sentences.zh: 他们看起来和其他四处走动的家庭没什么两样。

sentences.en: And I was not aware of that fact.
sentences.zh: 我之前并不知道这个事实。

sentences.en: And I was also not aware of the extent to which housing instability interrupted and damaged homeless children's education.
sentences.zh: 我也不知道住房不稳定在多大程度上中断和损害了无家可归儿童的教育。

sentences.en: Most of my reporting took place before the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 我的大部分报道是在疫情之前完成的。

sentences.en: And I saw the enormous challenges that homeless students face in getting an education.
sentences.zh: 我看到了无家可归的学生在接受教育方面面临的巨大挑战。

sentences.en: And obviously, the pandemic has brought a whole new set of challenges.
sentences.zh: 显然，疫情带来了一系列全新的挑战。

sentences.en: Most significantly, that at-home learning is incredibly challenging if you don't have a home.
sentences.zh: 最显著的一点是，如果你没有家，居家学习是非常困难的。

sentences.en: When schools in New York City abruptly closed in March because of the coronavirus pandemic, Prince, a bright, chatty nine-year-old bursting with kinetic energy, found
sentences.zh: 当纽约市的学校因为新冠疫情在三月份突然关闭时，普林斯——一个聪明、健谈、充满活力的九岁男孩——发现

sentences.en: himself at home plodding through the Google Classroom app on his mother's phone.
sentences.zh: 自己只能待在家里，用他妈妈的手机笨拙地操作 Google Classroom 应用程序。

sentences.en: The limbo that came with the shutdown was not a new experience for him.
sentences.zh: 停课带来的那种不确定状态对他来说并不陌生。

sentences.en: He and his mother, Fifi, who is 29, had been homeless for nearly his entire academic career.
sentences.zh: 他和29岁的母亲菲菲几乎在他整个求学期间都处于无家可归的状态。

sentences.en: To protect their privacy, their personal nicknames are being used to refer to Fifi and Prince.
sentences.zh: 为了保护隐私，文中用昵称来指代菲菲和普林斯。

sentences.en: He had attended five different elementary schools and missed many weeks of classes by the time the city's schools went online only.
sentences.zh: 在全市学校转为线上教学时，他已经换了五所小学，并错过了许多周的课程。

sentences.en: Like many of New York City's more than
sentences.zh: 像纽约市超过

sentences.en: 100,000 homeless school children, Prince was familiar with uncertainty and isolation, with not knowing what day it was.
sentences.zh: 10万名无家可归的在校儿童中的许多人一样，普林斯对不确定性和孤独感习以为常，对今夕何夕也毫无概念。

sentences.en: For nearly all his life, he had lived under the curfew imposed by homeless shelters, with no visitors or playdates allowed at his home, and had adapted to long,
sentences.zh: 他几乎一生都生活在无家可归者收容所实施的宵禁之下，家里不允许有访客或玩伴，他已经适应了在市政机构

sentences.en: endless waits at city agencies.
sentences.zh: 无休止的漫长等待。

sentences.en: Quarantine had coincidentally found him better situated than he had ever been.
sentences.zh: 巧合的是，隔离期让他处于比以往任何时候都更好的境地。

sentences.en: For the first time in Prince's memory, his family had a precarious hold on a rental apartment in the Bronx.
sentences.zh: 在普林斯的记忆中，这是他家第一次在布朗克斯区勉强租到了一间公寓。

sentences.en: Since Prince was little, teachers have been telling Fifi that with the right challenges and encouragement, he has enormous academic potential.
sentences.zh: 普林斯很小的时候，老师们就告诉菲菲，只要给予适当的挑战和鼓励，他有巨大的学术潜力。

sentences.en: Before the pandemic, Fifi had been looking for bigger academic opportunities for Prince, researching charter schools and gifted prograMs. All that was now on hold.
sentences.zh: 疫情前，菲菲一直在为普林斯寻找更好的学术机会，研究特许学校和天才项目。现在这一切都搁置了。

sentences.en: It was disappointing for both of them that Prince was not really learning anything as they tried to peck through screens, but they'd been there before.
sentences.zh: 当他们试图盯着屏幕学习时，却发现普林斯什么也没学到，这让他们俩都很失望，但他们以前也经历过这种情况。

sentences.en: When I first met Prince on a Thursday in March 2019, he had also been trying to keep up with school from his mother's tiny phone screen.
sentences.zh: 2019年3月的一个周四，我第一次见到普林斯时，他也在尝试用他妈妈那小小的手机屏幕跟上学校的进度。

sentences.en: His second grade class was working on a new unit.
sentences.zh: 他的二年级班级正在学习一个新的单元。

sentences.en: There would be a big test the following week.
sentences.zh: 下周将有一场大考。

sentences.en: Math was Prince's favorite subject, and he wanted to do well on the teSt.
sentences.zh: 数学是普林斯最喜欢的科目，他想在考试中取得好成绩。

sentences.en: When he brought home A's, his mother would buy him a new toy.
sentences.zh: 当他带回全A的成绩单时，他妈妈会给他买个新玩具。

sentences.en: Prince almost always delivered the grades.
sentences.zh: 普林斯几乎总是能拿到好成绩。

sentences.en: It wasn't hard.
sentences.zh: 这并不难。

sentences.en: He genuinely loved school.
sentences.zh: 他是真心热爱学校。

sentences.en: The teachers at his elementary school in East Harlem were kind.
sentences.zh: 他在东哈莱姆区就读的小学老师们都很友善。

sentences.en: There was a free after-school soccer program on Mondays, and the class took trips to parts of the city he'd never seen.
sentences.zh: 周一有免费的课后足球项目，班级还会去他从未见过的城市部分地区旅行。

sentences.en: Prince enrolled in that school just five months earlier, but had been absorbed into a group of friends and the rhythms of the classroom easily.
sentences.zh: 普林斯五个月前才转入那所学校，但很快就融入了一群朋友和课堂节奏中。

sentences.en: Prince was well-liked, and he knew it.
sentences.zh: 普林斯很受欢迎，他自己也知道。

sentences.en: If he arrived too late for school breakfast, he would flash his gap-toothed grin, and the cafeteria workers would wave him in to pick up a bagel on his way to class.
sentences.zh: 如果他去学校吃早餐迟到了，他会露出缺牙的笑容，食堂工作人员会向他招手，让他去拿个百吉饼再去上课。

sentences.en: But on that March morning in 2019, as his classmates settled into their seats in East Harlem, Prince, dressed in a puffy black coat and
sentences.zh: 但在2019年3月的那天早上，当他的同学们在东哈莱姆区的座位上坐好时，普林斯穿着一件蓬松的黑色外套和

sentences.en: jeans that slid down his slim frame, instead skipped up the ramp to the PATH intake center in the Bronx for homeless families.
sentences.zh: 一条在他瘦削身躯上滑落的牛仔裤，却蹦蹦跳跳地走上坡道，前往布朗克斯区为无家可归家庭设立的 PATH 接收中心。

sentences.en: Fifi, who is petite and has shiny brown hair, wore skinny jeans and a crossbody purse.
sentences.zh: 菲菲身材娇小，留着闪亮的棕色头发，穿着紧身牛仔裤，背着斜挎包。

sentences.en: Her boyfriend, Manuel, his middle name, who is 37 and whom Prince called Dad, followed.
sentences.zh: 她的男友曼努埃尔（他的中间名），37岁，普林斯叫他爸爸，跟在后面。

sentences.en: Carrying a backpack cooler full of the family's important documents and pushing a shopping cart loaded with neatly folded bedding and clothes packed in laundry and garbage bags.
sentences.zh: 他背着一个装满家庭重要文件的背包式冷藏箱，推着一辆装满整齐折叠的床上用品和用洗衣袋及垃圾袋打包的衣服的购物车。

sentences.en: PATH, prevention, assistance, and temporary housing, is where homeless families in New York City go to
sentences.zh: PATH（预防、援助和临时住房）是纽约市无家可归家庭去

sentences.en: apply for shelter, and where they go to reapply if they are initially found ineligible, or if they are logged out after missing check-in at their shelter for two nights in a row.
sentences.zh: 申请收容所的地方，也是如果他们最初被认定不符合资格，或者连续两晚错过收容所签到而被注销后，重新申请的地方。

sentences.en: The number of homeless New
sentences.zh: 纽约市无家可归者的数量

sentences.en: Yorkers has risen to the highest point since the Great Depression, and the largest demographic within the homeless population is children.
sentences.zh: 已升至大萧条以来的最高点，而无家可归人口中占比最大的是儿童。

sentences.en: As a result, the number of homeless students has increased nearly
sentences.zh: 因此，根据教育局的数据，无家可归学生的数量在过去十年中增加了近

sentences.en: 70% over the last decade, according to the Department of Education.
sentences.zh: 根据教育部的数据，过去十年间增长了70%。

sentences.en: Over the past two years,
sentences.zh: 在过去的两年里，

sentences.en: I've spoken with more than a dozen homeless families with school-age children as they struggled with the
sentences.zh: 我与十几户有学龄儿童的无家可归家庭交谈过，他们都在努力应对

sentences.en: often dueling imperatives of finding shelter and keeping their children in school.
sentences.zh: 寻找住所和让孩子继续上学这两个往往相互冲突的需求。

sentences.en: Despite making up a majority of the city's homeless population, homeless families are often not visible in the way single homeless adults can be.
sentences.zh: 尽管无家可归家庭占了城市无家可归人口的大多数，但他们往往不像单身无家可归成年人那样引人注目。

sentences.en: If a family is found living on the street, the children can be taken away by Child Protective Services.
sentences.zh: 如果一个家庭被发现露宿街头，儿童保护服务机构可能会带走他们的孩子。

sentences.en: The people walking into the PATH Center on any given day are mostly indistinguishable from those walking to the shopping center a few blocks away.
sentences.zh: 任何一天走进 PATH 中心的人，大多与那些走向几个街区外购物中心的人没什么两样。

sentences.en: You have to look closely to find the telltale giveaways, a few too many bags, or the little boy I met with his
sentences.zh: 你必须仔细观察才能发现明显的迹象，比如包太多了，或者我那天见到的那个小男孩，他

sentences.en: sister and mother on a sunny day dragging a large plastic Paw Patrol umbrella with a hooked handle, a prized possession that he wanted to have with him wherever he ended up next.
sentences.zh: 和姐姐、妈妈在一个阳光明媚的日子里，拖着一把带有钩形手柄的大型塑料汪汪队立大功雨伞，这是他无论接下来去哪里都想带在身边的珍贵财物。

sentences.en: New York City is the only place in America that guarantees a universal right to shelter,
sentences.zh: 纽约市是美国唯一一个保证普遍享有住房权的地方，

sentences.en: hard fought for by activists over decades in court and granted to men, women, and children by 1987.
sentences.zh: 这是活动人士几十年来在法庭上争取来的，并于1987年赋予了男性、女性和儿童。

sentences.en: In New York, this right has created a system incomparable to any other in the nation, a sprawling, incoherent megaplex that involves at least six city departments,
sentences.zh: 在纽约，这项权利创造了一个全国独一无二的系统，一个庞大且不连贯的综合体，涉及至少六个市政府部门，

sentences.en: which sometimes work at odds with one another and has a presence in hundreds of buildings in the city, offering very different levels of supervision and support.
sentences.zh: 它们有时相互抵触，在全市数百栋建筑中都有存在，提供截然不同的监管和支持水平。

sentences.en: In order to qualify to be placed in a homeless shelter, a family must document all residences from the previous two years and prove
sentences.zh: 为了有资格入住无家可归者收容所，家庭必须记录过去两年的所有居住地，并向

sentences.en: to PATH's fraud investigators that they cannot return to any of them.
sentences.zh: PATH 的欺诈调查员证明他们无法回到任何一个地方。

sentences.en: And if families become homeless because of domestic violence, as Prince's originally did, they have to provide each police report and
sentences.zh: 如果家庭是因为家庭暴力而变得无家可归，就像普林斯家最初的情况一样，他们必须在第一次去 PATH 中心时提供每一份警察报告和

sentences.en: restraining order when they first go to the PATH Center.
sentences.zh: 限制令。

sentences.en: In 2018, only 40 percent of families who applied for shelter at PATH met all the requirements and gained a placement.
sentences.zh: 2018年，在 PATH 申请收容所的家庭中，只有40%符合所有要求并获得了安置。

sentences.en: At the PATH Intake Center,
sentences.zh: 在 PATH 接收中心，

sentences.en: Manuel parked the family's cart in the luggage area.
sentences.zh: 曼努埃尔把家里的购物车停在行李区。

sentences.en: Prince settled into a gray vinyl chair.
sentences.zh: 普林斯坐在一张灰色乙烯基椅子上。

sentences.en: He would spend most of the next week at the center, along with many other city school children, watching boards that flashed the number of the next family to be called.
sentences.zh: 他将在中心度过接下来一周的大部分时间，和其他许多城市在校儿童一样，盯着显示下一个被叫到家庭编号的屏幕。

sentences.en: Experientially, PATH is like a multi-level department of motor vehicles.
sentences.zh: 从体验上讲，PATH 就像一个多层级的车管所。

sentences.en: Families arrive during the day and move from floor to floor, with long waits on each one, finally ending up on the basement level.
sentences.zh: 家庭白天到达，在楼层之间穿梭，每一层都要长时间等待，最后到达地下室。

sentences.en: From there, they might receive a housing assignment by midnight or later.
sentences.zh: 从那里，他们可能会在午夜或更晚的时候收到住房分配。

sentences.en: If they don't, they're bussed to a temporary overnight placement for some sleep, and then bussed back as early as six the next morning to continue waiting.
sentences.zh: 如果没收到，他们会被送往一个临时的过夜安置点睡觉，然后第二天早上六点就被送回来继续等待。

sentences.en: It was Fifi's ardent wish that Prince would manage to put himself on the other side of the city's divide and end up more like the people she had served, as a nanny or in jobs at
sentences.zh: 菲菲热切地希望普林斯能设法跨越城市的鸿沟，最终变得更像她曾经服务过的人，比如保姆，或者在

sentences.en: Whole Foods and food service at the airport.
sentences.zh: 全食超市和机场餐饮服务部门工作的人。

sentences.en: That's why she offered toys for good grades.
sentences.zh: 这就是她用玩具奖励好成绩的原因。

sentences.en: She and Manuel showed up together for every parent-teacher conference, checked in with Prince's
sentences.zh: 她和曼努埃尔一起参加了每一次家长会，在放学接孩子时与普林斯的

sentences.en: teacher at school pickup, and often took home the free books that were left in a box at the school entrance to read with Prince at night.
sentences.zh: 老师沟通，并经常把学校门口盒子里剩下的免费书籍带回家，晚上和普林斯一起阅读。

sentences.en: If Prince could have been in school instead of the PATH Center that Thursday, Fifi would have found a way.
sentences.zh: 如果那个周四普林斯能去上学而不是待在 PATH 中心，菲菲一定会想办法的。

sentences.en: But the city generally requires parents to bring their school-aged children to the center for the intake process, regardless of whether they're missing school.
sentences.zh: 但该市通常要求家长带学龄儿童到中心进行接收流程，无论他们是否因此缺课。

sentences.en: So at the center each day around 3 p.m., when school let out, Fifi logged into Prince's class app from her phone to download the day's math lesson.
sentences.zh: 所以每天下午3点左右学校放学时，菲菲都会在中心用手机登录普林斯的课堂应用程序，下载当天的数学课内容。

sentences.en: It was the most challenging work of the year, and the two poured over the lesson—subtraction on a number line, addition with regrouping tens—and
sentences.zh: 这是全年最具挑战性的功课，两人在等待时反复钻研这些课程——数轴上的减法、带进位的加法——并

sentences.en: reviewed the three pages inked in colored pen over and over as they waited.
sentences.zh: 一遍又一遍地复习那三页用彩色笔写下的内容。

sentences.en: Fifi and Prince entered the homeless shelter system when Prince was a baby, and Fifi fled a dangerous
sentences.zh: 菲菲和普林斯在普林斯还是婴儿时就进入了无家可归者收容系统，当时菲菲带着普林斯逃离了

sentences.en: situation at home with Prince's biological father to a temporary shelter for women escaping domestic violence.
sentences.zh: 家中危险的处境，躲进了一个为逃离家庭暴力的女性设立的临时收容所。

sentences.en: After Fifi's time at the domestic violence shelter ran out, she started looking for a rental apartment for herself and Prince.
sentences.zh: 在菲菲在家庭暴力收容所的时间结束后，她开始为自己和普林斯寻找出租公寓。

sentences.en: But working minimum-wage jobs, she was never able to save enough to afford New York City rents, and over the years, she and Prince bounced from shelter placement
sentences.zh: 但由于只能做最低工资的工作，她从未能存够钱来支付纽约市的房租，多年来，她和普林斯在不同的收容所之间

sentences.en: to shelter placement.
sentences.zh: 辗转搬迁。

sentences.en: In 2015, she met Manuel, and they moved to Florida, where they hoped to find better housing and work opportunities.
sentences.zh: 2015年，她遇到了曼努埃尔，他们搬到了佛罗里达州，希望能找到更好的住房和工作机会。

sentences.en: But after about a year and a half of difficulty finding jobs, they came back to New York, and eventually the three of them ended up in a shelter in East Harlem.

sentences.zh: 她和普林斯的父亲来自皇后区一个关系紧密的孟加拉国第一代

sentences.zh: 菲菲停止了在全食超市的工作，以避免见到那个亲戚。

sentences.en: She asked for a shelter transfer, but was told it would take up to six months.

sentences.zh: 在东哈莱姆区收容所一名工作人员的非正式建议下，

sentences.en: East Harlem shelter, Fifi decided to have the family stay away from the shelter for two nights, which would mean they were logged out and officially homeless again.
sentences.zh: 菲菲决定让全家离开收容所两晚，这意味着他们会被注销，再次正式成为无家可归者。

sentences.en: She and Manuel packed whatever belongings would fit in their shopping cart and the two crates the homeless shelter had

sentences.en: They left Prince's math posters, stuffed animals, and other belongings, vowing to replace them when they were settled in a new shelter.
sentences.zh: 他们留下了普林斯的数学海报、毛绒玩具和其他物品，发誓等在新的收容所安顿下来后再置办新的。

sentences.en: Prince, at this point, was used to losing things and moves.
sentences.zh: 此时的普林斯已经习惯了失去东西和搬家。

sentences.en: The only toy he really missed was a jumbo Nerf gun he got for Christmas one year.
sentences.zh: 他唯一真正怀念的玩具是有一年圣诞节他得到的超大号 Nerf 玩具枪。

sentences.en: The family walked with their shopping cart to
sentences.zh: 一家人推着购物车走到

sentences.zh: 曼努埃尔父亲在东哈莱姆区公共住房的一居室公寓。

sentences.zh: 那里已经非常拥挤，住了六个人。

sentences.zh: 浴室的门坏了，无法完全关上，墙上还有霉菌。

sentences.en: Fifi helped Prince shower in the bathroom for school, but she could not bring herself to use it.
sentences.zh: 菲菲帮普林斯在浴室洗澡准备上学，但她自己却无法忍受使用那个浴室。

sentences.en: Prince, Fifi, and Manuel slept on the floor of the apartment for two nights, but when they went back to the PATH Center, they were told that they had not been
sentences.zh: 普林斯、菲菲和曼努埃尔在公寓地板上睡了两晚，但当他们回到 PATH 中心时，被告知他们并没有

sentences.en: officially logged out, so they had to spend another two nights on the floor.
sentences.zh: 正式注销，所以他们不得不又在地板上睡了两晚。

sentences.en: On Thursday morning, having finally logged themselves out, they hoisted their metal shopping cart up the subway stairs to go to PATH.
sentences.zh: 周四早上，在终于完成注销后，他们把金属购物车抬上地铁楼梯，前往 PATH。

sentences.en: Prince had switched schools every time his family's shelter placement changed, so he had never completed more than one year in any school in New York.
sentences.zh: 普林斯每次家庭收容所安置点变动时都会转学，所以他在纽约的任何一所学校都没有读满过一年。

sentences.en: That year, he started asking his parents if he would be able to stay with his friends at his school in East Harlem.
sentences.zh: 那一年，他开始问父母他是否能留在东哈莱姆区的学校和朋友们在一起。

sentences.en: Fifi was happy with the instruction and the school culture.
sentences.zh: 菲菲对那里的教学和学校文化很满意。

sentences.en: I think it is my favorite school of all the ones he went to, she told me.
sentences.zh: “我认为这是他去过的所有学校中我最喜欢的一所，”她告诉我。

sentences.en: She was hoping that they would be placed close enough to the school to keep Prince there.
sentences.zh: 她希望他们能被安置在离学校足够近的地方，以便让普林斯留在那儿。

sentences.en: The Department of Homeless Services says it takes into account the neighborhood where the family's youngest child attends school in its

sentences.zh: 比尔·德布拉西奥市长的政府已将此作为一项政策重点。

sentences.en: Nonetheless, according to the 2020 Mayor's Management Report, only some 50 percent of city shelter placements in 2019
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，根据2020年市长管理报告，2019年只有约50%的城市收容所安置点

sentences.zh: 与最小孩子所在的学校位于同一个行政区，这一比例在今年前四个月上升到了60%。

sentences.en: Of the families I spoke to, only one had actually been placed close to their child's school.
sentences.zh: 在我交谈过的家庭中，只有一户真正被安置在离孩子学校很近的地方。

sentences.en: According to the department, this is partly because the vacancy rate in shelters is so low that it is hard to make precise placements.
sentences.zh: 据该部门称，部分原因是收容所的空置率太低，很难进行精确安置。

sentences.en: It's also partly because families fleeing domestic violence are not supposed to be placed in a shelter in the same borough as the abuser.
sentences.zh: 部分原因也是因为逃离家庭暴力的家庭不应被安置在与施暴者同一行政区的收容所。

sentences.en: Forty percent of all homeless families have some history of domestic violence.
sentences.zh: 所有无家可归家庭中有40%有家庭暴力史。

sentences.en: After some 13 hours at the PATH Center that Thursday, Fifi and Manuel received a new shelter placement.
sentences.zh: 那个周四在 PATH 中心待了约13个小时后，菲菲和曼努埃尔收到了一个新的收容所安置点。

sentences.zh: 当他们等待无家可归者服务部的货车来接他们时，菲菲白天遇到的一位母亲告诉她，水晶之家是个糟糕的地方，房间里有臭虫，门外还有毒贩。

sentences.en: during the day, told her that Crystal's was a bad place, that it had bedbugs in the rooms and drug dealers out front.
sentences.zh: 当他们等待无家可归者服务部的货车来接他们时，菲菲白天遇到的一位母亲告诉她，水晶之家是个糟糕的地方，房间里有臭虫，门外还有毒贩。

sentences.zh: 菲菲仔细地打量了一下四周。

sentences.zh: 在2014年之前，这栋建筑曾是卡普里怀特斯通酒店，

sentences.en: When the Department of Homeless Services turned it into a family shelter, it left up the signs advertising the Capri Whitestone and its 555
sentences.zh: 当无家可归者服务部将其改建为家庭收容所时，他们保留了卡普里怀特斯通酒店及其555休息室的招牌，

sentences.en: lounge, and people would continue to arrive looking for it, until a local state senator petitioned the department to remove the signs.
sentences.zh: 人们依然会不断前来寻找这家旅馆，直到一位当地州参议员请愿要求该部门拆除这些招牌。

sentences.zh: 据新闻报道，第二年，该部门将两名被定罪的性犯罪者安置在水晶之家，其中一人曾猥亵过儿童。

sentences.en: The department did not respond to a majority of fact-checking requests.
sentences.zh: 该部门对大多数事实核查请求未予回应。

sentences.zh: 入口处的毒贩，正如PATH中心那位女士所描述的那样。

sentences.zh: 前往地铁站的公交车服务点在半英里多以外。

sentences.zh: 曼努埃尔给父亲打了电话，他叫了一辆优步把他们送到地铁站，然后他们乘车回到了他在东哈莱姆区的公寓。

sentences.en: Over the course of 2019, 132,660 people slept in the New York City municipal shelter system.
sentences.zh: 2019年全年，共有132,660人在纽约市的市政收容系统中过夜。

sentences.en: Over two-thirds were families, and almost 45,000 were children.
sentences.zh: 其中超过三分之二是家庭，近45,000人是儿童。

sentences.en: Those statistics don't represent the true number of children without stable homes in the city—children whose families are doubled up at a friend's house

sentences.en: or staying in a cheap motel.
sentences.zh: 或住在廉价汽车旅馆里的孩子们。

sentences.en: In some cases, families who have been denied eligibility for shelter might park their children at a relative's home or with a babysitter for the night while they sleep on a subway
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，被拒绝收容资格的家庭可能会把孩子安置在亲戚家或保姆那里过夜，而他们自己则睡在地铁里

sentences.en: or in a hallway.
sentences.zh: 或走廊里。

sentences.zh: 联邦法律《麦金尼-文托无家可归者援助法案》要求公立学校询问入学学生关于其住房状况的信息。

sentences.en: At the end of last year, families in New York City reported that 114,000 school-aged children met the McKinney-Vento definition of homelessness,
sentences.zh: 去年年底，纽约市的家庭报告称，有114,000名学龄儿童符合《麦金尼-文托法案》对无家可归者的定义，

sentences.zh: 即缺乏固定、常规且适宜的夜间住所。

sentences.zh: 纽约市拥有全国最大的公立学校系统，学生人数超过110万。

sentences.en: The number of students who are homeless is larger than the entire school populations of
sentences.zh: 无家可归的学生人数比波士顿、印第安纳波利斯和罗切斯特

sentences.zh: 三地的学生总数加起来还要多。

sentences.zh: 无家可归儿童涌入城市学校系统的情况与全国趋势相呼应。

sentences.en: The number of homeless students in the United States has increased by
sentences.zh: 过去十年中，美国的无家可归学生人数增加了

sentences.zh: 70%，且没有任何放缓的迹象。

sentences.zh: 去年，该市43%的无家可归学生属于长期缺勤（定义为缺课达到学年的10%或以上），相比之下，贫困学生中这一比例为30%，

sentences.zh: 而非贫困学生中仅为16%。

sentences.zh: 市审计长办公室2018年的一项审计发现，在调查的长期缺勤学生中，有34%的学生没有证据显示学校曾进行过外展干预。

sentences.zh: 在全国范围内，学生无家可归现象的增加已经持续多年，但大多未得到重视，研究也很匮乏。

sentences.zh: “大多数关于无家可归的研究都集中在单身无家可归成年人身上，”全国性非营利组织Schoolhouse Connection的负责人芭芭拉·达菲尔德说，

sentences.en: organization that focuses on homelessness and education.
sentences.zh: 该组织专注于无家可归和教育问题。

sentences.zh: 经济适用房的匮乏，已经导致一部分低收入者永久性地退出了住房市场。

sentences.en: Homeless families slept on metal cots in gyms and auditoriums, in wards at the Bellevue Psychiatric Hospital, and in welfare hotels with deplorable conditions.
sentences.zh: 无家可归的家庭睡在体育馆和礼堂的金属折叠床上，睡在贝尔维尤精神病院的病房里，以及条件恶劣的福利旅馆中。

sentences.en: During his tenure, Koch announced a 10-year plan to create 150,000 affordable housing units,
sentences.zh: 在任期间，科赫宣布了一项为期10年的计划，旨在建造15万套经济适用房，

sentences.en: later revising this to 252,000 units, and to allocate 15,000 of them to homeless households.
sentences.zh: 后来将目标修订为25.2万套，并拨出1.5万套供无家可归家庭使用。

sentences.en: He also began developing shelters for families, which were assumed at the time to be an interim measure.
sentences.zh: 他还开始为家庭开发收容所，当时人们认为这只是临时措施。

sentences.en: When Mayor David Dinkins took office in 1990, he added social services to family shelters and continued to offer priority for public housing to homeless families.
sentences.zh: 1990年大卫·丁金斯市长上任时，他为家庭收容所增加了社会服务，并继续为无家可归家庭提供公共住房优先权。

sentences.en: The homeless family population grew, and a theory developed among some policy experts that the practice of offering homeless
sentences.zh: 无家可归家庭的数量不断增长，一些政策专家中出现了一种理论，认为向无家可归

sentences.en: families priority placement in affordable housing provided incentives for people to enter the shelter system.
sentences.zh: 家庭提供经济适用房优先安置权，反而激励了人们进入收容所系统。

sentences.en: This theory was later refuted.
sentences.zh: 这一理论后来被驳斥了。

sentences.en: But when Rudolph W.
sentences.zh: 但当鲁道夫·W·

sentences.en: Giuliani became mayor, he sought to discourage people from entering the shelter system.
sentences.zh: 朱利安尼担任市长时，他试图阻止人们进入收容所系统。

sentences.en: Although Giuliani continued the practice of placing shelter residents in public housing and in Section 8 housing, he did not invest in shelter infrastructure,
sentences.zh: 尽管朱利安尼延续了将收容所居民安置在公共住房和第8条款住房中的做法，但他并没有投资收容所的基础设施，

sentences.en: and made it harder to apply for placement.
sentences.zh: 并增加了申请安置的难度。

sentences.en: He started the cluster site program in 2000, paying market rates to landlords of apartments that were often of poor quality to house homeless people with little oversight.
sentences.zh: 他在2000年启动了集群点项目，以市场价格向通常质量低劣的公寓房东支付租金，在几乎没有监管的情况下安置无家可归者。

sentences.en: Michael R.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·R·

sentences.en: Bloomberg came into office with a pledge to cut homelessness by two thirds.
sentences.zh: 布隆伯格上任时承诺将无家可归人数减少三分之二。

sentences.en: He initially stopped offering homeless families priority placement for public housing and Section 8 programs and established a rental subsidy called the Advantage Program.
sentences.zh: 他最初停止向无家可归家庭提供公共住房和第8条款项目的优先安置权，并建立了一项名为“优势计划”的租金补贴。

sentences.en: And at first, the homeless population dropped.
sentences.zh: 起初，无家可归人口确实有所下降。

sentences.en: Advocates for the homeless were critical of the program's work requirements and temporary nature and lobbied against it.
sentences.zh: 无家可归者权益倡导者批评该计划的工作要求和临时性质，并进行了游说反对。

sentences.en: Governor Andrew M.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁·M·

sentences.en: Cuomo withdrew funding, and the program ended in 2011.
sentences.zh: 科莫州长撤回了资金，该计划于2011年结束。

sentences.en: As a result, tens of thousands of families were evicted.
sentences.zh: 结果，数万个家庭被驱逐。

sentences.en: During Bloomberg's tenure, the shelter population grew from 37,000 in 2010 to nearly 61,000 by the end of 2014, 70% of whom were families.
sentences.zh: 在布隆伯格任内，收容所人口从2010年的3.7万人增长到2014年底的近6.1万人，其中70%是家庭。

sentences.en: When de Blasio was elected, he walked into a storm.
sentences.zh: 当德布拉西奥当选时，他陷入了一场风暴。

sentences.en: He had campaigned on reducing income inequality and had promised to lower the homeless population.
sentences.zh: 他竞选时主张减少收入不平等，并承诺降低无家可归人口数量。

sentences.en: He initially instituted anti-eviction measures and rental subsidies, which moved many people out of shelters but couldn't stop the flow of others into the homeless system.
sentences.zh: 他最初实施了反驱逐措施和租金补贴，这使许多人搬出了收容所，但无法阻止其他人流入无家可归系统。

sentences.en: In 2017, de Blasio unveiled a second plan, turning the tide on homelessness, to invest in shelter infrastructure, reduce the reliance on
sentences.zh: 2017年，德布拉西奥公布了第二项计划，旨在扭转无家可归的局面，投资收容所基础设施，减少对

sentences.en: hotels and cluster housing, and mitigate some of the worst impacts of family homelessness.
sentences.zh: 旅馆和集群住房的依赖，并减轻家庭无家可归带来的一些最严重的影响。

sentences.en: The plan calls for the construction of 90 shelters, including family shelters, 39 of which have opened, according to the Department of Homeless
sentences.zh: 该计划要求建造90个收容所，包括家庭收容所，据无家可归者服务部称，

sentences.en: Services.
sentences.zh: 其中39个已经开放。

sentences.en: These shelters have social service providers and offer things like after-school prograMs. They are unusual in that they are in neighborhoods that have never had shelters.
sentences.zh: 这些收容所配备了社会服务提供者，并提供课后辅导等项目。它们的不同之处在于，它们位于从未有过收容所的社区。

sentences.en: The hope is that by increasing capacity, more families can be placed near anchors of life, especially schools.
sentences.zh: 希望通过增加容量，让更多的家庭能被安置在生活支点附近，尤其是学校附近。

sentences.en: Today, no one imagines that family homelessness in New York City is a temporary emergency.
sentences.zh: 今天，没有人再认为纽约市的家庭无家可归是一个临时紧急情况。

sentences.en: It is a tacitly accepted part of the picture of what it means to be poor here.
sentences.zh: 这是这里贫困生活图景中被默许的一部分。

sentences.en: According to an analysis by the National Low-Income Housing Coalition, New York and its surrounding metro area currently has
sentences.zh: 根据国家低收入住房联盟的分析，纽约及其周边大都市区目前有

sentences.en: 950,673 extremely low-income renter households.
sentences.zh: 950,673户极低收入租房家庭。

sentences.en: The number of units for such households is 321,000.
sentences.zh: 而此类家庭的住房单元数量仅为32.1万套。

sentences.en: Even if the goals of turning the tide are met, the city will still have a population of some 65,000 homeless families, according to the Institute for
sentences.zh: 据非营利研究和倡导组织“儿童、贫困与无家可归研究所”称，即使实现了扭转局面的目标，该市仍将有约6.5万户无家可归家庭。

sentences.en: Children, Poverty and Homelessness, a non-profit research and advocacy organization.
sentences.zh: 儿童、贫困与无家可归研究所，一家非营利研究和倡导组织。

sentences.en: Last year, the city spent roughly $3.2 billion on homeless services, more than double what it spent in 2014, according to a controller report.
sentences.zh: 据审计长报告显示，去年该市在无家可归者服务上花费了约32亿美元，是2014年支出的两倍多。

sentences.en: The average length of stay in a shelter is 474 days.
sentences.zh: 收容所的平均停留时间为474天。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息，就能探索《时报》呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Stephen Banks, one of the original Legal Aid Society lawyers who went to court to fight for
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬·班克斯，最初为争取收容权而诉诸法庭的法律援助协会律师之一，

sentences.en: a right to shelter, is the city commissioner of social services and oversees the Department of
sentences.zh: 现任市社会服务专员，负责监管无家可归者服务部。

sentences.en: Homeless Services.
sentences.zh: 无家可归者服务部。

sentences.en: Banks told me that the right to shelter has transformed lives in New York City, and he also pointed to Los Angeles, where many more homeless people live in unsheltered situations.
sentences.zh: 班克斯告诉我，收容权改变了纽约市的生活，他还提到了洛杉矶，那里有更多无家可归者生活在露天环境中。

sentences.en: But, he said, if he could have brought the case as a right to housing in addition to shelter, he would have.
sentences.zh: 但他表示，如果他能同时以住房权而非仅仅是收容权提起诉讼，他一定会这样做。

sentences.en: Temporary versus permanent housing and other resources is equivalent to having a debate
sentences.zh: 他说，临时住房与永久住房及其他资源之间的争论，等同于

sentences.en: in the healthcare sector over funding emergency rooms or just preventative medicine, he said.
sentences.zh: 医疗领域关于资助急诊室还是仅资助预防医学的辩论。

sentences.en: Of course you need both.
sentences.zh: 当然，两者都需要。

sentences.en: Nunez, who is now the president and chief executive of the Institute for
sentences.zh: 努涅斯，现任儿童、贫困与无家可归研究所的总裁兼首席执行官，他说：

sentences.en: Children, Poverty, and Homelessness, says that,
sentences.zh: 儿童、贫困与无家可归研究所，他说：

sentences.en: After years and years of growing the shelter system, it's time to call it what it really is, a surrogate for affordable housing.
sentences.zh: “在多年不断扩大收容所系统之后，是时候认清它的真面目了，它是经济适用房的替代品。”

sentences.en: But unlike the affordable housing programs of the past, rent-regulated apartments, federally funded Section 8 vouchers, the shelter system is,
sentences.zh: 但与过去的经济适用房项目、租金管制公寓、联邦资助的第8条款凭证不同，收容所系统，

sentences.en: in Nunez's words, creating a whole class of poverty nomads, a generation that is getting accustomed to nomadism.
sentences.zh: 用努涅斯的话说，正在创造一整类“贫困游民”，这一代人正在习惯这种游牧生活。

sentences.en: The consequences of this nomadism go beyond education.
sentences.zh: 这种游牧生活的后果远不止教育方面。

sentences.en: The norms at many homeless shelters can be jail-like and put a heavy social burden on children.
sentences.zh: 许多无家可归收容所的规范可能像监狱一样，给孩子们带来了沉重的社会负担。

sentences.en: Families are not allowed to have any visitors in their rooms and have to be present at nightly curfew.
sentences.zh: 家庭不允许在房间里接待任何访客，并且必须遵守每晚的宵禁。

sentences.en: They must sign in and out every time they come and go.
sentences.zh: 他们每次进出都必须签到和签退。

sentences.en: Some families told me that they were not allowed to bring in furniture, including air conditioners, microwave ovens, TVs, or a mini trampoline, if an autistic child requires
sentences.zh: 一些家庭告诉我，他们不被允许带入家具，包括空调、微波炉、电视，或者如果自闭症儿童需要用来平静情绪的迷你蹦床，也不允许带入。

sentences.en: one to calm herself.
sentences.zh: 一个。

sentences.en: I was also told by residents at various shelters that nail clippers, scooters, and flip-flops were forbidden.
sentences.zh: 我从不同收容所的居民那里还得知，指甲刀、滑板车和人字拖是被禁止的。

sentences.en: And some families said that shelter personnel used the threat of calling child protective services as a way to enforce their rules.
sentences.zh: 一些家庭说，收容所工作人员利用威胁要打电话给儿童保护服务机构作为执行规则的手段。

sentences.en: One afternoon in September 2018, after school let out, I met Angel, who was from a Puerto Rican family and was 17 at the time.
sentences.zh: 2018年9月的一个下午，放学后，我见到了安吉尔，他来自一个波多黎各家庭，当时17岁。

sentences.en: He was wearing vans and earrings.
sentences.zh: 他穿着Vans鞋，戴着耳环。

sentences.en: He, his mother, and his little brother, RJ, had been evicted from their Bronx apartment in December 2017 and were living in a family shelter in Brooklyn.
sentences.zh: 他和母亲以及小弟弟RJ在2017年12月被从布朗克斯的公寓驱逐，当时住在布鲁克林的一个家庭收容所里。

sentences.en: To protect their privacy, only their first names are being used.
sentences.zh: 为了保护隐私，仅使用他们的名字。

sentences.en: RJ had switched to the school near their shelter, but Angel was old enough to make the daily three-subway commute back to the Bronx to continue at his high school.
sentences.zh: RJ已经转学到收容所附近的学校，但安吉尔已经大到可以每天乘坐三趟地铁回到布朗克斯，继续在他原来的高中上学。

sentences.en: After school, Angel said, his friends would go home, have a snack, and play video games, talking on their headsets until they met up later.
sentences.zh: 安吉尔说，放学后，他的朋友们会回家，吃点零食，玩电子游戏，戴着耳机聊天，直到稍后见面。

sentences.en: Angel wanted to stay in the Bronx to play basketball with his friends when they went out later, so he would walk around the neighborhood near
sentences.zh: 安吉尔想留在布朗克斯，等朋友们出来后一起打篮球，所以他会在学校附近的社区走来走去，消磨时间，也许在祖母开始地铁售票员轮班前去她家坐坐。

sentences.en: school, killing time, maybe stopping at his grandmother's house before her shift as a subway conductor began.
sentences.zh: 学校，消磨时间，也许在祖母开始地铁售票员轮班前去她家坐坐。

sentences.en: I just wait for someone to text me where they decided to meet up, he explained, as we sat on a bench near the subway stop in the Bronx.
sentences.zh: “我只是等别人发短信告诉我他们决定在哪里见面，”当我们坐在布朗克斯地铁站附近的长椅上时，他解释道。

sentences.en: Angel ate a foot-long marinara sub and drank a blue Gatorade.
sentences.zh: 安吉尔吃了一个一英尺长的番茄酱三明治，喝了一瓶蓝色佳得乐。

sentences.en: The move had taken an academic toll.
sentences.zh: 这次搬迁对学业造成了影响。

sentences.en: Angel said that there was no desk or a comfortable place to do homework in the shelter, and that he had fallen off the honor roll.
sentences.zh: 安吉尔说，收容所里没有书桌或舒适的地方做作业，他的成绩已经跌出了荣誉榜。

sentences.en: But there was also a social toll.
sentences.zh: 但这也造成了社交上的损失。

sentences.en: People always ask why I have to go home so early, why I never stay over, he told me.
sentences.zh: “人们总是问我为什么回家那么早，为什么从不留宿，”他告诉我。

sentences.en: Angel was stoic when he told me about a pool party that he couldn't go to because of the shelter curfew.
sentences.zh: 当安吉尔告诉我他因为收容所宵禁而无法参加泳池派对时，他表现得很坚忍。

sentences.en: But he became agitated, describing a weekend morning when his mother let him sleep in while she took RJ to football practice in the Bronx.
sentences.zh: 但他变得激动起来，描述了一个周末的早晨，母亲让他多睡一会儿，而她带RJ去布朗克斯参加足球训练。

sentences.en: A shelter supervisor came out, and she screamed at my mother in front of everyone that they're going to call CPS if she ever leaves me sleeping in the room
sentences.zh: “一位收容所主管走出来，当着所有人的面对我母亲大喊大叫，说如果她再让我一个人留在房间里睡觉，他们就要打电话给儿童保护服务机构，”

sentences.en: again, he said, his face seared with shame.
sentences.zh: 他说，脸上带着羞愧的表情。

sentences.en: I didn't mind that I will now have to get up at 7am on a weekend, but I minded a lot that they yelled at my mother in front of everyone.
sentences.zh: “我不介意现在周末必须7点起床，但我非常介意他们当着所有人的面对我母亲大喊大叫。”

sentences.en: They made her cry.
sentences.zh: 他们让她哭了。

sentences.en: They threatened her.
sentences.zh: 他们威胁她。

sentences.en: In April 2019, the family was able to move to a shelter back in the Bronx, where RJ, who was 8 at the time, started his third school in 18 months.
sentences.zh: 2019年4月，这家人得以搬回布朗克斯的一个收容所，当时8岁的RJ在18个月内开始了第三所学校的学习。

sentences.en: RJ, who has chubby cheeks and soft black hair, showed me a swimming pool at a nearby housing project and excitedly said his mother had promised to teach him to swim there.
sentences.zh: RJ有着胖乎乎的脸颊和柔软的黑发，他向我展示了附近一个住房项目里的游泳池，并兴奋地说妈妈答应教他在那里游泳。

sentences.en: Then he paused and added the qualification, if we still live here in the summer.
sentences.zh: 然后他停顿了一下，补充了一个前提：“如果我们夏天还住在这里的话。”

sentences.en: They did not live there by summer.
sentences.zh: 到了夏天，他们已经不住在那里了。

sentences.en: Over a snack at McDonald's, I asked RJ, who was repeating first grade, if students in his newest class knew that he was homeless.
sentences.zh: 在麦当劳吃零食时，我问正在重读一年级的RJ，他新班级的同学是否知道他是无家可归的。

sentences.en: He looked at me as though I were crazy.
sentences.zh: 他看着我，好像我疯了一样。

sentences.en: I don't tell anyone I'm homeless, RJ said.
sentences.zh: “我没告诉任何人我无家可归，”RJ说。

sentences.en: Everyone else has a house or an apartment.
sentences.zh: “其他人都有房子或公寓。”

sentences.en: His mother pointed out to him that another child in his class also lived in the shelter, a fact they discovered one afternoon when the boys returned from school at the same time.
sentences.zh: 他的母亲向他指出，班上另一个孩子也住在收容所，这是他们一天下午发现的，当时两个男孩同时从学校回来。

sentences.en: I asked RJ if he played with his classmate at the shelter, and he again looked at me with utter bafflement.
sentences.zh: 我问RJ是否在收容所和同学一起玩，他再次用完全困惑的眼神看着我。

sentences.en: No one can come in your room, not even your cousins, he said.
sentences.zh: “没人能进你的房间，连表亲都不行，”他说。

sentences.en: And if we played in the hallway, the security would yell.
sentences.zh: “如果我们要在走廊里玩，保安就会大喊大叫。”

sentences.en: One Thursday in May 2019, I waited with a father named Alan on a street corner in South Brooklyn,
sentences.zh: 2019年5月的一个星期四，我和一位名叫艾伦的父亲在南布鲁克林的一个街角等候，

sentences.en: near the homeless shelter where he lived.
sentences.zh: 靠近他居住的无家可归者收容所。

sentences.en: He was waiting for the school bus carrying his first grade daughter, London.
sentences.zh: 他正在等载着他上一年级的女儿伦敦的校车。

sentences.en: To protect their privacy, Alan and London are identified by their middle names.
sentences.zh: 为了保护隐私，艾伦和伦敦使用中间名作为标识。

sentences.en: She was coming home from her school in Queens, where she had enrolled when they lived in a shelter there.
sentences.zh: 她正从皇后区的学校回家，那是他们住在那里的一家收容所时给她报名的学校。

sentences.en: The driver had said the bus would arrive at 3.30.
sentences.zh: 司机说校车会在3点30分到达。

sentences.en: Though the bus was often late, Alan had to leave work early and be there just in case.
sentences.zh: 虽然校车经常晚点，但艾伦必须早点下班赶过去，以防万一。

sentences.en: If he missed the bus, he worried that he might be reported to Child Protective Services.
sentences.zh: 如果错过了校车，他担心自己可能会被举报给儿童保护服务机构。

sentences.en: Alan, who is black, is tall and wears a baseball cap slightly cocked to the side and holds a steady, gentle gaze.
sentences.zh: 艾伦是黑人，身材高大，戴着一顶稍微歪斜的棒球帽，目光坚定而温柔。

sentences.en: He is 32 and works for a city agency as a mentor for young fathers in the foster care system.
sentences.zh: 他今年32岁，在一家市政府机构工作，担任寄养系统中年轻父亲的导师。

sentences.en: He told me that he spent time in the foster care system as a child and served time as a minor for selling drugs.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，他小时候在寄养系统中度过，并因贩毒在未成年时服过刑。

sentences.en: He got his high school equivalency diploma while incarcerated on Rikers Island, and some years after he was released, London was born.
sentences.zh: 他在赖克斯岛服刑期间获得了高中同等学力证书，在他获释几年后，伦敦出生了。

sentences.en: She lived with her mother, but when she turned two, Alan said, her mother told him she could no longer take care of her.
sentences.zh: 她曾和母亲住在一起，但艾伦说，当她两岁时，母亲告诉他她无法再照顾她了。

sentences.en: Alan, who had been living on Long Island, didn't have a suitable apartment for London to move into.
sentences.zh: 一直住在长岛的艾伦没有合适的公寓让伦敦搬进去。

sentences.en: He entered the New York City shelter system, he said, and the city later placed him in an apartment in the Bronx and paid the moving costs.
sentences.zh: 他说，他进入了纽约市的收容所系统，后来市政府把他安置在布朗克斯的一间公寓里，并支付了搬家费用。

sentences.en: Alan leaned in to parenting London.

sentences.en: He fusses over her, worrying that she looks messy if he can't take her to his aunts to get her hair braided, and he special ordered a Little Mermaid birthday cake she wanted.
sentences.zh: 他为她操心，担心如果不能带她去姑妈那里编头发，她看起来会很邋遢，他还特意为她订做了她想要的《小美人鱼》生日蛋糕。

sentences.en: That Thursday, hours passed, and still no bus arrived.
sentences.zh: 那个星期四，几个小时过去了，校车还是没来。

sentences.en: Alan went back to his shelter room for a while, where he could watch for the bus through the window.
sentences.zh: 艾伦回了一趟收容所的房间，在那里他可以通过窗户观察校车。

sentences.en: At 6 p.m., London's bus finally pulled up.
sentences.zh: 下午6点，伦敦的校车终于停下了。

sentences.zh: 艾伦对司机说：“伙计，这看起来像3点30分吗？”

sentences.zh: 司机耸了耸肩。

sentences.en: I forgot two kids, he said.
sentences.zh: 他说，我忘了两个孩子。

sentences.en: I had to go back.
sentences.zh: 我不得不回去。

sentences.en: Alan climbed the steps.
sentences.zh: 艾伦走上台阶。

sentences.en: London, who had now been riding on the yellow school bus long enough to have gotten halfway across Delaware, made no move to get off.
sentences.zh: 伦敦已经在黄色校车上坐了足够久，足以横跨特拉华州的一半路程，但她没有表现出要下车的意思。

sentences.en: She sat on the brown vinyl-covered bench, stupefied, the contents of her bags scattered through the bus.
sentences.zh: 她坐在棕色乙烯基覆盖的长椅上，神情呆滞，包里的东西散落在车厢各处。

sentences.en: Aw, your stuff is everywhere, Alan said, as he scooped up her pink-flowered coat and an I-can-read book and put them into her inside-out backpack.
sentences.zh: 艾伦一边把她那件印有粉色花朵的外套和一本《我会阅读》系列书捡起来，塞进她那翻过来的书包里，一边说：噢，你的东西到处都是。

sentences.zh: 艾伦牵着伦敦的手走在街上。

sentences.zh: 走到街区一半时，她隔着父亲皮大衣的袖子咬了他的手臂，那种接触和他的反应似乎让她重新找回了身体的感觉。

sentences.zh: 她开始向他汇报自己这一天的情况。

sentences.zh: 最初的几周里，

sentences.zh: 珀西，取自《托马斯和朋友们》系列。

sentences.zh: 伦敦曾在附近的一所学校上学前班，一位老师建议她可以申请天才班。

sentences.en: London had been notably ahead of her peers for a while, Alan said.

sentences.zh: 两岁时，她就认识了所有的颜色、感官和数字，并且能用完整的非幼儿句子说话。

sentences.zh: 艾伦自豪地回忆道，她幼儿园里的其他孩子几乎还不会说话。

sentences.zh: 但艾伦的薪水无法负担房租。

sentences.zh: 谈到房租时，他严峻地说：我没法给她买衣服、鞋子、食物，同时还要支付房租。

sentences.en: When they were evicted, they were placed at the shelter in Queens, and Alan enrolled London in kindergarten at the zoned school up the block from the shelter.
sentences.zh: 当他们被驱逐后，他们被安置在皇后区的一家收容所，艾伦给伦敦报名了收容所街区那所划片学校的幼儿园。

sentences.zh: 在皇后区收容所的一天，

sentences.zh: 艾伦告诉我，他把伦敦独自留在房间里，走到隔壁房间去和人说话。

sentences.en: London wandered out into the hall, and Alan said a shelter staff member reported him to Child
sentences.zh: 伦敦溜到了走廊里，艾伦说，一名收容所工作人员向儿童

sentences.zh: 伦敦被寄养了90天，期间他参加了强制性的育儿课程。

sentences.en: During that time, Alan went to a shelter for single men in Brooklyn, and London's foster family enrolled her in a different school in Queens that was close to their house.

sentences.en: After three months, when the two were reunited, they were placed in a family shelter in Brooklyn.
sentences.zh: 三个月后，当两人团聚时，他们被安置在布鲁克林的一家家庭收容所。

sentences.en: London had to take a 90-minute school bus ride to and from her school in Queens each day, but it was workable.
sentences.zh: 伦敦每天必须乘坐90分钟的校车往返于皇后区的学校，但这还是可行的。

sentences.en: Then, during first grade in December 2018, the city announced that the family shelter in Brooklyn, where Alan and
sentences.zh: 然后，在2018年12月读一年级时，市政府宣布艾伦和

sentences.en: London lived, would be converted into a men's shelter, so they were transferred to a shelter even farther from London's school.
sentences.zh: 伦敦居住的布鲁克林家庭收容所将被改建为男性收容所，因此他们被转移到了离伦敦学校更远的地方。

sentences.en: The commute would take an hour to drive, but it is two and a half hours by mass transit on a good day, and the city did not immediately provide school bus service.
sentences.zh: 开车通勤需要一个小时，但乘坐公共交通工具在顺利的情况下需要两个半小时，而且市政府没有立即提供校车服务。

sentences.en: London missed two weeks of first grade waiting for the school bus to show up at her new shelter.
sentences.zh: 伦敦因为等待校车出现在新收容所而错过了两周的一年级课程。

sentences.en: When it finally did, it was a disaster.
sentences.zh: 当校车终于出现时，却是一场灾难。

sentences.en: Although Alan woke London at 5 a.m.
sentences.zh: 尽管艾伦早上5点就叫醒伦敦，

sentences.en: so the school bus could take her to Queens, it often dropped her off at school an hour late, and she would miss her first period.
sentences.zh: 好让校车带她去皇后区，但校车经常让她迟到一小时，导致她错过了第一节课。

sentences.en: Her teacher sent home the lessons London missed for Alan to review with her, but the bus ride home was even worse, often taking three hours.
sentences.zh: 她的老师把伦敦错过的课程寄回家让艾伦帮她复习，但回家的车程更糟糕，经常需要三个小时。

sentences.en: By the time she got home, did homework, ate dinner, and showered, the work from first period was not getting done.
sentences.zh: 等她回到家、做完作业、吃完晚饭、洗完澡，第一节课的作业根本做不完。

sentences.en: It's piled so high, Alan told me that Thursday in the spring of
sentences.zh: 2019年春天的那个周四，艾伦告诉我：作业堆得太高了，

sentences.en: 2019, I don't know when we will do it.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我们什么时候能做完。

sentences.en: Alan was then faced with the choice that nearly every homeless family I'd met agonized over, whether to continue to unpredictably uproot their children from school
sentences.zh: 艾伦当时面临着我遇到的几乎每个无家可归家庭都感到痛苦的选择：是每次搬家时都不可预测地让孩子转学，

sentences.en: every time they moved, or endure the brutal commute.
sentences.zh: 还是忍受残酷的通勤。

sentences.en: I like the teacher, I like the principal, I like the school, he told me.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我：我喜欢那个老师，我喜欢校长，我喜欢这所学校。

sentences.en: I didn't want to keep switching her.
sentences.zh: 我不想一直让她转学。

sentences.en: I like that she has all these friends.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢她有这么多朋友。

sentences.en: Alan understood the dangers of switching schools.
sentences.zh: 艾伦明白转学的危险。

sentences.en: Every time she changes schools, she loses time.
sentences.zh: 他说：每次她转学，她都会浪费时间。

sentences.en: The teachers don't know her, she doesn't know them, and she falls more and more behind, he said.
sentences.zh: 老师不认识她，她也不认识老师，她会越来越落后。

sentences.en: She started kindergarten ahead of grade level, he added, and I just got a letter that this year she may be held back.
sentences.zh: 他补充说：她上幼儿园时进度超前，但我刚收到一封信，说今年她可能会留级。

sentences.en: Alan's experience is borne out by most research about mid-year transfers, which shows that these changes usually cause academic setbacks for children.
sentences.zh: 艾伦的经历被大多数关于学年中途转学的研究所证实，这些研究表明，这些变动通常会导致儿童学业受挫。

sentences.en: There was a school down the street from his Brooklyn shelter.
sentences.zh: 他布鲁克林收容所的街对面就有一所学校。

sentences.en: But what if I start her there and we get transferred again?
sentences.zh: 但如果我让她在那里上学，我们又被转移了怎么办？

sentences.zh: 艾伦痛苦地问道。

sentences.en: She makes friends, leaves them, makes friends, leaves them.
sentences.zh: 她交了朋友，又离开他们，再交朋友，又离开他们。

sentences.en: It's not good.
sentences.zh: 这不好。

sentences.en: I don't want her to be a loner.
sentences.zh: 我不希望她成为一个孤独的人。

sentences.en: Before the start of second grade in September 2019,
sentences.zh: 在2019年9月二年级开学前，

sentences.en: Alan knew he couldn't sustain the lost hours of work and London's missed first periods any longer, so he did enroll her in the school down the block from their Brooklyn shelter.
sentences.zh: 艾伦知道他无法再维持因工作时间损失和伦敦错过第一节课的情况，所以他确实让她报名了布鲁克林收容所街区的那所学校。

sentences.en: Then, in December, he got off the waiting list for public housing, and he and London moved to a building in Harlem.
sentences.zh: 然后，在12月，他排到了公共住房的候补名单，他和伦敦搬到了哈莱姆区的一栋大楼里。

sentences.en: He used the furniture allowance he was given to take London to her Brooklyn school in cabs for weeks until the bus came to Harlem.
sentences.zh: 他用得到的家具补贴，连续几周打车送伦敦去布鲁克林的学校，直到校车开通到哈莱姆区。

sentences.en: He managed to buy London a nice bed, but he sleeps on a mattress pad on the floor, and the apartment is mostly unfurnished.
sentences.zh: 他设法给伦敦买了一张不错的床，但他自己睡在地板上的床垫上，公寓里几乎没有家具。

sentences.en: For two weeks after the schools closed down in March because of the coronavirus, Alan had to report to work in Midtown Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 3月份因冠状病毒学校关闭后的两周里，艾伦不得不去曼哈顿中城上班。

sentences.en: He hired a babysitter to stay home with London and fell behind on rent.
sentences.zh: 他雇了一个保姆在家陪伦敦，结果房租拖欠了。

sentences.zh: 从4月开始，

sentences.zh: 在市政府首次被无家可归家庭涌入打个措手不及近40年后，安置他们的系统仍然不可预测且杂乱无章。
