sentences.zh: 当她转过身不看儿子时，她声音里的温柔消失了，她因愤怒和恐慌而燃烧，描述着这次安置中不可能实现的后勤安排。

sentences.en: She began to cry and told me that she couldn't get upset in front of her son.
sentences.zh: 她开始哭泣，告诉我她不能在儿子面前表现得难过。

sentences.en: We would have to talk later.
sentences.zh: 我们以后再谈。

sentences.en: Elizabeth texted me the number of her room at the Prince Flushing Hotel, a small, boxy, new building on a block with Chinese restaurants.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白给我发短信告知了她在法拉盛王子酒店的房间号，那是一栋位于中餐馆街区的小型、方方正正的新建筑。

sentences.en: As the Department of Homeless Services van transported her and her children to the hotel, I took a car to meet her.
sentences.zh: 当无家可归者服务局的货车将她和孩子们送到酒店时，我开车去见她。

sentences.en: When I arrived, I told the desk clerk that I wanted to visit room 505.
sentences.zh: 我到达后，告诉前台职员我想去505房间。

sentences.en: He looked bewildered.
sentences.zh: 他看起来很困惑。

sentences.en: Uh, the fifth floor is not part of the hotel, he said, although of course the fifth floor was part of the hotel, stacked right on top of the third and fourth floors.
sentences.zh: 他说：呃，五楼不属于酒店的一部分，尽管五楼当然是酒店的一部分，就堆在三楼和四楼之上。

sentences.en: He was adamant that no visitors could go to the fifth floor.
sentences.zh: 他坚持认为任何访客都不能去五楼。

sentences.en: He said the hotel was sold out that night, so I booked a room for the next night on Booking.com.
sentences.zh: 他说那天晚上酒店客满了，所以我通过Booking.com预订了第二天晚上的房间。

sentences.en: The next day, I checked into my room on the second floor and rode the elevator to the fifth floor in the hopes of talking to Elizabeth, but by then she
sentences.zh: 第二天，我入住了二楼的房间，并乘电梯去了五楼，希望能和伊丽莎白谈谈，但那时她

sentences.en: had decided to move back in with relatives in an apartment closer to her children's school and child care.
sentences.zh: 已经决定搬回亲戚家，住进离她孩子学校和托儿所更近的公寓里。

sentences.en: I stayed at the hotel anyway.
sentences.zh: 我还是留在了酒店。

sentences.en: In the elevator, I chatted with a tourist toting her pink, flowered NYC souvenir backpack.
sentences.zh: 在电梯里，我和一位带着粉色花朵NYC纪念品背包的游客聊天。

sentences.en: At the breakfast area for guests, I got a cup of coffee next to a hotel guest on his laptop and then walked maybe 30 feet down the hallway, where the Department of Homeless
sentences.zh: 在客人的早餐区，我在一位用笔记本电脑的酒店客人旁边喝了一杯咖啡，然后沿着走廊走了大约30英尺，那里无家可归

sentences.en: Services quietly admitted homeless families and handed out meals that could be microwaved in rooms, away from the guests.
sentences.zh: 服务局悄悄地接纳无家可归的家庭，并分发可以在房间里用微波炉加热的餐食，远离其他客人。

sentences.en: I identified myself as a reporter and asked if I could speak with someone.
sentences.zh: 我表明了自己的记者身份，并询问是否可以和某人谈谈。

sentences.en: The social service worker looked flummoxed.
sentences.zh: 社会服务工作者看起来很困惑。

sentences.en: Journalists are generally not allowed in department shelters or the PATH Center.
sentences.zh: 记者通常不允许进入部门收容所或PATH中心。

sentences.en: She phoned someone who seemed to oversee the area's hotels.
sentences.zh: 她给似乎负责该地区酒店的人打了电话。

sentences.en: A few minutes later, that person charged in, reprimanded me for trespassing, and demanded that I leave the property.
sentences.zh: 几分钟后，那个人冲了进来，斥责我擅闯，并要求我离开该物业。

sentences.en: I explained that I had paid for a room in the hotel, and then no one knew what to do.
sentences.zh: 我解释说我付了酒店房间的钱，然后没人知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: PS-401 in the Brownsville neighborhood of Brooklyn is the zoned school for two large homeless shelters, which house over 400 families.
sentences.zh: 布鲁克林布朗斯维尔社区的PS-401学校是两个大型无家可归者收容所的划片学校，收容了超过400个家庭。

sentences.en: The backs of the shelters face a rail line.
sentences.zh: 收容所的背面正对着铁路线。

sentences.en: Nearby is a scrap metal facility and a recycling center piled with mountains of bags filled with plastic bottles.
sentences.zh: 附近有一个废金属设施和一个堆满了装满塑料瓶的袋子的回收中心。

sentences.en: Of the 338 students who attended PS-401 during the 2018-19 school year, 104 lived in temporary housing,
sentences.zh: 在2018-19学年就读PS-401的338名学生中，104人住在临时住所，

sentences.en: 89 were in homeless shelters, and 15 were doubled up.
sentences.zh: 89人住在无家可归者收容所，15人寄居在他人处。

sentences.en: In one kindergarten class, three-quarters of the students were homeless.
sentences.zh: 在一个幼儿园班级里，四分之三的学生是无家可归者。

sentences.en: More than half of PS-401 students were chronically absent.
sentences.zh: 超过一半的PS-401学生长期缺勤。

sentences.en: Homeless students attend all but a dozen of New York City's 1,600 non-charter public schools,
sentences.zh: 无家可归的学生就读于纽约市1600所非特许公立学校中的绝大多数，

sentences.en: but they are much more highly concentrated in schools in high-poverty areas like Brownsville.
sentences.zh: 但他们更集中在布朗斯维尔等高贫困地区的学校。

sentences.en: According to Advocates for Children of New York, during the 2018-19 school year, there were three other city districts where at least one in five students were homeless.
sentences.zh: 根据纽约儿童倡导组织的说法，在2018-19学年，还有三个城市学区至少有五分之一的学生是无家可归者。

sentences.en: Schools have traditionally been organized around place, parish, zone.
sentences.zh: 学校传统上是围绕地点、教区、区域组织的。

sentences.en: Now that roughly one-tenth of city students are untethered to a place, in the last few years the de Blasio administration and the Department of Education,
sentences.zh: 现在，大约十分之一的城市学生与地点脱节，在过去几年里，白思豪政府和教育部，

sentences.en: under Chancellor Richard Carranza, have made efforts to focus on homeless students.
sentences.zh: 在理查德·卡兰萨校长的领导下，努力关注无家可归的学生。

sentences.en: The department formally placed responsibility for students in temporary housing with two upper-level
sentences.zh: 该部门正式将临时住所学生的责任交给了两位高层

sentences.en: officials, Chris Caruso, a senior executive director of the Office of Community Schools, which helps underserved students and tries to improve attendance, and LaShawn Robinson,
sentences.zh: 官员：社区学校办公室高级执行主任克里斯·卡鲁索（他帮助服务不足的学生并试图提高出勤率），以及拉肖恩·罗宾逊，

sentences.en: the deputy chancellor for school climate and wellness.
sentences.zh: 负责学校氛围和健康的副校长。

sentences.en: They have increased the number of regional managers and community coordinators to help homeless students, and over the past year,
sentences.zh: 他们增加了区域经理和社区协调员的数量来帮助无家可归的学生，在过去的一年里，

sentences.en: they have spent $15 million to, among other things, hire more than 100 bridging-the-gap social workers to aid the unstably-housed student population.
sentences.zh: 他们花费了1500万美元，其中包括聘请了100多名“弥合差距”的社会工作者来帮助住房不稳定的学生群体。

sentences.en: At PS401, Shandell Wilson, a social worker, was appointed to care for the unstably-housed children, and Reginald LaRouge was brought on to coordinate efforts for
sentences.zh: 在PS401，社会工作者尚德尔·威尔逊被任命照顾住房不稳定的儿童，雷金纳德·拉鲁日被聘请来协调

sentences.en: students in temporary housing.
sentences.zh: 临时住所学生的事务。

sentences.en: I visited the school twice in June 2019.
sentences.zh: 我在2019年6月两次访问了这所学校。

sentences.en: When I first met Wilson, she told me, these children have so much weight on them.
sentences.zh: 当我第一次见到威尔逊时，她告诉我：这些孩子承受着太大的压力。

sentences.en: Children understand.
sentences.zh: 孩子们是懂的。

sentences.en: We don't give them credit for how well they know their circumstances.
sentences.zh: 我们低估了他们对自己处境的了解程度。

sentences.en: Every morning, Wilson, LaRouge, and the principal,
sentences.zh: 每天早上，威尔逊、拉鲁日和校长

sentences.en: Dion Mitchell, began their day in the cinderblock cafeteria with yellow-painted radiators, where many of the children ate the free breakfast provided by the city.
sentences.zh: 迪翁·米切尔都在带有黄色散热器的煤渣砖食堂开始他们的一天，许多孩子在那里吃市政府提供的免费早餐。

sentences.en: They assessed how the children were, who was too tired or too stressed to go directly into the classroom, and set the tone for the day.
sentences.zh: 他们评估孩子们的情况，谁太累或压力太大而无法直接进入教室，并为这一天定下基调。

sentences.en: During breakfast, they oriented the children about what day and month it was, because they said children who switch schools a lot and miss days sometimes lose the narrative thread.
sentences.zh: 早餐期间，他们会引导孩子们了解今天是几月几日，因为他们说经常转学和缺课的孩子有时会失去叙事线索。

sentences.en: One morning, I joined the team before breakfast began.
sentences.zh: 一天早上，我在早餐开始前加入了团队。

sentences.en: The children were coming back after a one-day holiday.
sentences.zh: 孩子们在一天假期后回来。

sentences.en: Wilson wore a belted dress and flat sandals, and her hair was arranged in a regal swirl atop her head.
sentences.zh: 威尔逊穿着一条系带连衣裙，穿着平底凉鞋，头发在头顶盘成一个高贵的发髻。

sentences.en: She took a deep breath before she entered the auditorium, where children who arrive early, before breakfast is served, wait.
sentences.zh: 她在进入礼堂前深吸了一口气，那些早到、在早餐供应前到达的孩子们都在那里等待。

sentences.en: A second grader, whose hair was threaded with beads, sidled up to her.
sentences.zh: 一个头发上串着珠子的二年级学生悄悄走到她身边。

sentences.en: This is my beauty, Wilson told me.
sentences.zh: 威尔逊告诉我：这是我的小美人。

sentences.en: The girl smiled delightedly.
sentences.zh: 女孩开心地笑了。

sentences.en: Are you looking for a hug?
sentences.zh: 想要个拥抱吗？

sentences.en: Wilson asked.
sentences.zh: 威尔逊问道。

sentences.en: The girl nodded yes.
sentences.zh: 女孩点了点头。

sentences.en: Wilson squeezed her to her side and told her she would check in when she had breakfaSt.
sentences.zh: 威尔逊把她搂在身边，告诉她等吃完早餐会去看看她。

sentences.en: Wilson then entered the cafeteria, where workers were handing out pancakes, cereal, and previously frozen omelets in perfect semicircles.
sentences.zh: 随后威尔逊走进食堂，工人们正在分发煎饼、麦片和预先冷冻好的半圆形煎蛋卷。

sentences.en: She tried to make contact with each of the unstably housed children at breakfast, except for the kindergartners, whom she connects with at lunch.
sentences.zh: 她试图在早餐时与每一位居无定所的孩子接触，除了幼儿园的孩子，她会在午餐时与他们交流。

sentences.en: They were bobbing and squirming at their table, all chipmunk cheeks, glitter headbands, and braids.
sentences.zh: 孩子们在桌边蹦蹦跳跳、扭来扭去，一个个脸蛋圆鼓鼓的，戴着亮闪闪的发带，扎着辫子。

sentences.en: She waved to them.
sentences.zh: 她向他们挥了挥手。

sentences.en: That's my kindergarten class, she told me.
sentences.zh: “那是我的幼儿园班级，”她告诉我。

sentences.en: Some of those kids are so smart, she added proudly, and a little wistfully.
sentences.zh: “有些孩子非常聪明，”她自豪地补充道，语气中带着一丝惆怅。

sentences.en: Wilson approached two boys with their heads lying on their crossed arms, not eating breakfaSt. Good morning, brothers.
sentences.zh: 威尔逊走到两个男孩身边，他们正把头埋在交叉的双臂上，没有吃早餐。“早上好，兄弟俩。”

sentences.en: You had a day off.
sentences.zh: “你们休息了一天。”

sentences.en: Did you do anything?
sentences.zh: “做了什么吗？”

sentences.en: One brother shook his head no.
sentences.zh: 其中一个兄弟摇了摇头。

sentences.en: Are you tired today?
sentences.zh: “今天累了吗？”

sentences.en: They nodded.
sentences.zh: 他们点了点头。

sentences.en: Come, walk with Ms. Wilson.
sentences.zh: “来，跟威尔逊老师走。”

sentences.en: We are going to get some water to splash on your face, and we are going to have a great day today.
sentences.zh: “我们要去弄点水洗洗脸，今天一定会过得很棒。”

sentences.en: Wilson returned to the second grader with the beads in her hair and sat next to her.
sentences.zh: 威尔逊回到那个头发上扎着珠子的二年级女孩身边，坐在她旁边。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: “早上好。”

sentences.en: How was your day off?
sentences.zh: “休息日过得怎么样？”

sentences.en: I did a lot of things.
sentences.zh: “我做了很多事。”

sentences.en: My mom made me lunch, and I had strawberries on Oreo ice cream, and I played with slime.
sentences.zh: “妈妈给我做了午饭，我吃了奥利奥冰淇淋配草莓，还玩了史莱姆。”

sentences.en: She paused and added, I was excited to come back today so I can have a new start with what we talked about.
sentences.zh: 她停顿了一下，补充道：“我很兴奋今天能回来，这样我就能按照我们谈过的那样重新开始了。”

sentences.en: Ooh, Wilson beamed.
sentences.zh: “噢，”威尔逊笑逐颜开。

sentences.en: Then she asked, what did we talk about?
sentences.zh: 然后她问：“我们谈过什么？”

sentences.en: The relaxation response for when I get anxious and upset, the girl said solemnly.
sentences.zh: “当我感到焦虑和不安时使用的放松反应，”女孩严肃地说。

sentences.en: The second grader transferred to PS 401 in October
sentences.zh: 这个二年级学生是在2018年10月转学到PS 401小学的，

sentences.en: 2018, before Wilson started working there, and for a while she was known only as a very smart, very competitive student who got high grades.
sentences.zh: 那时威尔逊还没开始在那里工作。有一段时间，她只被视为一个非常聪明、好胜心强、成绩优异的学生。

sentences.en: Then, one day in November, she got into a disagreement with a student in her class.
sentences.zh: 后来，在11月的一天，她和班上的一名同学发生了争执。

sentences.en: The teacher asked her to step outside to diffuse the situation and told her that she would come out and speak to her in a moment.
sentences.zh: 老师让她到外面去缓和一下情绪，并告诉她过一会儿会出来和她谈谈。

sentences.en: Out in the hallway, the girl let out a piercing scream and pulled a bulletin board down with a huge crash.
sentences.zh: 在走廊里，女孩发出一声刺耳的尖叫，把一块公告栏拽倒在地，发出一声巨响。

sentences.en: She ran through the halls, yelling, throwing things, and tearing down bulletin boards.
sentences.zh: 她在走廊里奔跑、大喊大叫、乱扔东西，还撕毁了公告栏。

sentences.en: Security guards intervened.
sentences.zh: 保安介入了。

sentences.en: It took Mitchell, the principal, a full half hour to calm her down.
sentences.zh: 校长米切尔花了整整半个小时才让她平静下来。

sentences.en: Mitchell said she had to take off her high heels and was sweating from the physical effort of it.
sentences.zh: 米切尔说她不得不脱掉高跟鞋，因为剧烈的体力消耗，她出了一身汗。

sentences.en: Wilson and Mitchell didn't know under what circumstances the girl moved to one of the nearby shelters, and they didn't know much about where she was before.
sentences.zh: 威尔逊和米切尔不知道这个女孩是在什么情况下搬到附近收容所的，对她以前的情况也知之甚少。

sentences.en: Wilson told me, what I do know is she doesn't like to feel a sense of loss and can't handle disappointment, and I know that as soon as she de-escalates from her anger,
sentences.zh: 威尔逊告诉我：“我所知道的是，她不喜欢那种失落感，无法承受失望。我知道一旦她从愤怒中冷静下来，

sentences.en: she apologizes and asks, are you still proud of me?
sentences.zh: 她就会道歉并问：‘你还为我感到骄傲吗？’

sentences.en: Do you still love me?
sentences.zh: ‘你还爱我吗？’

sentences.en: And wants to be held.
sentences.zh: 并且想要得到拥抱。”

sentences.en: Earlier that week, the girl was playing musical chairs in the gym.
sentences.zh: 那周早些时候，女孩在体育馆玩抢椅子游戏。

sentences.en: When the music stopped and she lost her chair, she got angry and started screaming and hyperventilating.
sentences.zh: 当音乐停止而她没抢到椅子时，她变得很生气，开始尖叫并过度换气。

sentences.en: But she was able to use some breathing techniques that Wilson had taught her and calm down within minutes.
sentences.zh: 但她能够运用威尔逊教给她的呼吸技巧，在几分钟内平静了下来。

sentences.en: The whole episode was very short, Mitchell said.
sentences.zh: “整个过程非常短，”米切尔说。

sentences.en: It was a massive improvement from the fall when it took all hands in the building to manage her.
sentences.zh: “这比秋天时有了巨大的进步，那时需要全校的人手才能管住她。”

sentences.en: The girl had told Wilson that she prays at night that Wilson will remain at P.S.
sentences.zh: 女孩曾告诉威尔逊，她每天晚上祈祷威尔逊能留在P.S.

sentences.en: That morning in the cafeteria, she looked at me, following Wilson and holding my notepad, and then back at Wilson.
sentences.zh: 那天早上在食堂，她看着我，跟着威尔逊，手里拿着我的笔记本，然后又看向威尔逊。

sentences.en: She asked Wilson in a panicked tone, are you leaving?
sentences.zh: 她惊慌地问威尔逊：“你要走了吗？”

sentences.en: She thought I might be training to take over Wilson's job.
sentences.zh: 她以为我可能是在接受培训，准备接替威尔逊的工作。

sentences.en: The girl was also the only child in the school who remembered Mitchell's birthday.
sentences.zh: 这个女孩也是学校里唯一记得米切尔生日的孩子。

sentences.en: She gave her a Little Debbie honey bun and a $1 bill.
sentences.zh: 她送给她一个Little Debbie蜂蜜面包和一张1美元的钞票。

sentences.en: When most of the students had finished breakfast, Mitchell headed to the front of the cafeteria with an air of gravitas.
sentences.zh: 当大多数学生吃完早餐后，米切尔带着一种庄重的神情走向食堂前方。

sentences.en: She reminded the children, we are in the home stretch of the year.
sentences.zh: 她提醒孩子们：“我们正处于这一年的最后冲刺阶段。”

sentences.en: Let's end strong.
sentences.zh: “让我们以最好的状态结束。”

sentences.en: We are at the finish line.
sentences.zh: “我们已经到达终点线了。”

sentences.en: It's been a while since we sent a strong, loud message to everyone in
sentences.zh: “我们已经很久没有向布朗斯维尔的每一个人发出响亮而有力的信息了。”

sentences.en: Brownsville.
sentences.zh: 布朗斯维尔。

sentences.en: Everyone needs to wake up to what we are.
sentences.zh: “每个人都需要清醒地认识到我们是谁。”

sentences.en: A group of older girls started pounding on hand drums, and the cafeteria came to life, chanting, we are 401.
sentences.zh: 一群大一点的女孩开始敲击手鼓，食堂顿时活跃起来，齐声高喊：“我们是401！”

sentences.en: Our school is on the rise, working hard to win the race.
sentences.zh: “我们的学校正在崛起，努力赢得这场比赛。”

sentences.en: No time for nonsense.
sentences.zh: “没时间胡闹。”

sentences.en: No time to waste.
sentences.zh: “没时间浪费。”

sentences.en: Mitchell implored the students to repeat after her.
sentences.zh: 米切尔恳求学生们跟着她重复。

sentences.en: Say, I am great.
sentences.zh: “说，我很棒。”

sentences.en: Nothing can stop me from my greatness.
sentences.zh: “没有什么能阻挡我的伟大。”

sentences.en: The girl with the beaded hair screamed back at the top of her lungs, eyes shining happily.
sentences.zh: 那个头发上扎着珠子的女孩用尽全力尖叫着回应，双眼闪烁着快乐的光芒。

sentences.en: After breakfast, Reginald LaRouge, the coordinator, went upstairs to a room where he reviews attendance records for the day.
sentences.zh: 早餐后，协调员雷金纳德·拉鲁日上楼去了一个房间，在那里他查看当天的出勤记录。

sentences.en: The office was filled with boxes of phonics books and an old lavender color rotary phone hung on one wall.
sentences.zh: 办公室里堆满了自然拼读教材的盒子，墙上挂着一部老式的薰衣草色转盘电话。

sentences.en: LaRouge was wearing a red polo, khakis, and boat shoes.
sentences.zh: 拉鲁日穿着一件红色Polo衫、卡其裤和船鞋。

sentences.en: He made his first call to a family at one of the shelters down the street, and offered to walk down the block and take the child to school if the parent could meet him halfway.
sentences.zh: 他给街那头收容所的一户家庭打了第一个电话，并提出如果家长能走一半路程来接应，他就走过去把孩子带到学校。

sentences.en: You can still make it.
sentences.zh: “你还来得及。”

sentences.en: We can change attendance before 11, he said hopefully.
sentences.zh: “我们可以在11点前更改出勤记录，”他充满希望地说。

sentences.en: Around 10 a.m., a school aide brought in a boy who looked to be about 9 or 10, with messy hair, who had arrived at school late, and then acted out in class.
sentences.zh: 上午10点左右，一位学校助理带来了一个看起来大约9或10岁、头发凌乱的男孩，他上学迟到了，还在课堂上捣乱。

sentences.en: What can we do better?
sentences.zh: “我们怎样才能做得更好？”

sentences.en: LaRouge asked.
sentences.zh: 拉鲁日问道。

sentences.en: You were not only late today, you also got yourself kicked out of class two times.
sentences.zh: “你今天不仅迟到了，还两次被赶出教室。”

sentences.en: While the boy was there, LaRouge tried to follow up on his nearly two dozen absences.
sentences.zh: 在男孩在场时，拉鲁日试图跟进他近两打的缺勤记录。

sentences.en: LaRouge had previously gone to the Brooklyn shelter that was listed as the boy's home address to speak with his
sentences.zh: 拉鲁日之前曾去过男孩家庭住址登记的布鲁克林收容所与他的

sentences.en: parents, only to find that the family had been moved to a shelter in the Bronx.
sentences.zh: 父母交谈，结果发现这家人已经被转移到了布朗克斯的一个收容所。

sentences.en: Why weren't you here Monday?
sentences.zh: “你周一为什么没来？”

sentences.en: He asked the boy, who looked at him blankly.
sentences.zh: 他问男孩，男孩茫然地看着他。

sentences.en: What happened the day before yesterday?
sentences.zh: “前天发生了什么事？”

sentences.en: LaRouge asked again.
sentences.zh: 拉鲁日再次问道。

sentences.en: I had to go with my uncle to get eye surgery, he said.
sentences.zh: “我得陪我叔叔去做眼科手术，”他说。

sentences.en: Your sister was not here either, LaRouge said.
sentences.zh: “你姐姐也没来，”拉鲁日说。

sentences.en: Yeah, she helped him walk because he couldn't see with his eye.
sentences.zh: “是的，她帮他走路，因为他眼睛看不见。”

sentences.en: Attendance is really important, LaRouge said.
sentences.zh: “出勤真的很重要，”拉鲁日说。

sentences.en: You have to be here every day.
sentences.zh: “你必须每天都来。”

sentences.en: Did the surgery take all day?
sentences.zh: “手术花了一整天吗？”

sentences.en: No, it took 15 minutes, he replied, but I couldn't come to school after because the doctor was all the way in the Bronx.
sentences.zh: “没有，只花了15分钟，”他回答，“但我之后没法来学校，因为医生在布朗克斯那么远的地方。”

sentences.en: Even if you want to help a special person in your life, you can come to school after, okay?
sentences.zh: “即使你想帮助生命中特别的人，你之后也可以来学校，好吗？”

sentences.en: LaRouge told him.
sentences.zh: 拉鲁日告诉他。

sentences.en: After LaRouge entered the day's attendance data, he did a circuit through the halls, checking in with students who had missed school recently.
sentences.zh: 拉鲁日录入当天的出勤数据后，在走廊里巡视了一圈，查看最近缺课的学生情况。

sentences.en: Children in the hallway also came to him looking for a hug, just as they did with Wilson.
sentences.zh: 走廊里的孩子们也像对待威尔逊一样，跑过来找他要拥抱。

sentences.en: He tried to redirect them to fist bumps.
sentences.zh: 他试图引导他们改用碰拳的方式。

sentences.en: Acknowledgement is huge in this school, huge, he told me.
sentences.zh: “认可在这所学校非常重要，非常重要，”他告诉我。

sentences.en: LaRouge peeked in on the kindergarten class, where three-quarters of the students were homeless, and found a girl sitting apart from her classmates looking morose.
sentences.zh: 拉鲁日探头看了看幼儿园班级，那里四分之三的学生无家可归，发现一个女孩独自坐在同学中间，神情忧郁。

sentences.en: He asked her to come out to the hallway, crouched down, and addressed her gently.
sentences.zh: 他让她到走廊来，蹲下身子，温柔地对她说话。

sentences.en: I came to see how you were doing, he said.
sentences.zh: “我来看看你怎么样了，”他说。

sentences.en: You weren't here on Monday.
sentences.zh: “你周一没来。”

sentences.en: Do you know why you weren't here?
sentences.zh: “你知道你为什么没来吗？”

sentences.en: The girl rubbed her eyes and shook her head no.
sentences.zh: 女孩揉了揉眼睛，摇了摇头。

sentences.en: Are you okay?
sentences.zh: “你还好吗？”

sentences.en: LaRouge asked.
sentences.zh: 拉鲁日问道。

sentences.en: She shook her head no.
sentences.zh: 她摇了摇头。

sentences.en: Did you eat today?
sentences.zh: “你今天吃东西了吗？”

sentences.en: The girl looked blankly at him.
sentences.zh: 女孩茫然地看着他。

sentences.en: Okay, LaRouge said uncertainly.
sentences.zh: “好吧，”拉鲁日不确定地说。

sentences.en: I'll be back in a little to check in with you.
sentences.zh: “我过一会儿再回来看看你。”

sentences.en: He sent her back to her classroom.
sentences.zh: 他让她回到了教室。

sentences.en: His next stop was to follow up with a fifth-grade boy, a twin who had lived in one of the local family shelters for five years, to find out why he most recently missed school.
sentences.zh: 他的下一站是跟进一名五年级男生，这是一对双胞胎中的一个，已经在当地的一家家庭收容所住了五年，他想找出他最近缺课的原因。

sentences.en: LaRouge tried to keep it light.
sentences.zh: 拉鲁日试图让气氛轻松些。

sentences.en: The boy was a Stephen Curry fan, and LaRouge had bought a Curry jersey, which he kept in his office.
sentences.zh: 这个男孩是斯蒂芬·库里的粉丝，拉鲁日买了一件库里的球衣，一直放在办公室里。

sentences.en: He had told the boy that if he came to school for one full week at any point that year, five consecutive days, he would give the jersey to him.
sentences.zh: 他曾告诉男孩，如果他那一年里任何时候能完整地上一周学，即连续五天，就把球衣送给他。

sentences.en: But so far, the boy had not been able to earn the jersey.
sentences.zh: 但到目前为止，男孩还没能赢得这件球衣。

sentences.en: LaRouge told the boy, I want this jersey out of my office before the year ends.
sentences.zh: 拉鲁日告诉男孩：“我希望在这一年结束前，这件球衣能离开我的办公室。”

sentences.en: I'm not a Golden State fan.
sentences.zh: “我可不是金州勇士队的粉丝。”

sentences.en: PS401 shares a building with a K-8 charter school, Leadership Prep Ocean Hill, which has higher test scores than PS401.
sentences.zh: PS401小学与一所K-8特许学校“海洋山领导力预备学校”共用一栋楼，后者的考试成绩比PS401高。

sentences.en: It also has far fewer homeless students enrolled, despite its identical proximity to the shelters.
sentences.zh: 尽管距离收容所的距离完全相同，但它招收的无家可归学生要少得多。

sentences.en: About one in ten students at Ocean Hill are homeless, compared with more than one in four at PS401.
sentences.zh: 海洋山学校大约十分之一的学生无家可归，而PS401这一比例超过四分之一。

sentences.en: Mitchell told me that sometimes PS401's more stable families transfer their children
sentences.zh: 米切尔告诉我，有时PS401家庭状况较稳定的学生会转学

sentences.en: upstairs, where they are better shielded from the challenges that the very poorest and most transient students bring.
sentences.zh: 到楼上，在那里他们能更好地免受最贫困、流动性最强的学生所带来的挑战。

sentences.en: Mitchell, whom I had mostly seen imploring children to chant that nothing can stop them, suddenly seemed weary.
sentences.zh: 米切尔，我之前大多看到她恳求孩子们高喊没有什么能阻挡他们，此刻却显得疲惫不堪。

sentences.en: Speaking of the kindergarten class, in which three-quarters of the students were unstably housed, she said, We've been working so hard to prepare them for the first
sentences.zh: 谈到那个四分之三学生居无定所的幼儿园班级时，她说：“我们一直在努力为他们升入一年级做准备，

sentences.en: grade, and I would love to keep them.
sentences.zh: 我非常希望能留住他们。”

sentences.en: Will I have them in September?
sentences.zh: “九月份我还能有他们吗？”

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: “没有。”

sentences.en: I will have a totally new crop of children.
sentences.zh: “我将迎来一批全新的孩子。”

sentences.en: We have no ability to transfer what we are working so hard to do because we are starting over every year with a completely new group of students.
sentences.zh: “我们没有能力延续我们努力工作的成果，因为我们每年都在面对一群全新的学生，一切从头开始。”

sentences.en: When the pandemic closed schools,
sentences.zh: 当疫情导致学校关闭时，

sentences.en: Mitchell went to the two shelters that are zoned for PS401 and run by Wynn to hand out gift cards for groceries.
sentences.zh: 米切尔去了由Wynn运营、划片给PS401的两家收容所，分发杂货礼品卡。

sentences.en: At first, that second-grade girl didn't show up online, and Mitchell worked with shelter employees to help her get connected.
sentences.zh: 起初，那个二年级女孩没有上线，米切尔与收容所员工合作，帮助她建立联系。

sentences.en: The challenges of at-home learning for the city's many children without a home have worried advocates for homeless children since March, when they unsuccessfully
sentences.zh: 自3月份以来，城市中许多无家可归儿童居家学习所面临的挑战一直让无家可归儿童权益倡导者感到担忧，当时他们曾试图

sentences.en: campaigned to get access for all homeless students to regional enrichment centers set up by the city for children of essential workers.
sentences.zh: 争取让所有无家可归学生都能进入城市为必要工作人员子女设立的区域充实中心，但未获成功。

sentences.en: A national survey of 600 public school teachers conducted in May by
sentences.zh: 5月份由“卓越教育者”组织对600名公立学校教师进行的一项全国性调查显示，

sentences.en: Educators for Excellence about the effects of school shutdowns on their students found that only 21% of teachers said homeless students' needs were often met.
sentences.zh: 关于学校停课对学生的影响，只有21%的教师表示无家可归学生的需求得到了满足。

sentences.en: The New York City Department of Education has not released information about engagement in online learning for students in temporary housing.
sentences.zh: 纽约市教育局尚未发布关于临时住所学生参与在线学习的信息。

sentences.en: In May, I spoke to Chris Caruso, the Office of Community Schools Senior Executive Director,
sentences.zh: 5月，我采访了社区学校办公室高级执行主任克里斯·卡鲁索，

sentences.en: and he would tell me only that the average rate of interaction for all students in the city
sentences.zh: 他只告诉我，全市所有学生的平均互动率

sentences.en: was 88%, a number the Department of Education later updated to 86%, which can mean just a single interaction each day.
sentences.zh: 是88%，教育局后来将这个数字更新为86%，这可能仅仅意味着每天只有一次互动。

sentences.en: We have a caring adult checking in with students who are living in homeless shelters, he said, connecting with these students around access to technology.
sentences.zh: “我们有爱心的成年人会查看住在收容所的学生的情况，”他说，“并就技术接入问题与这些学生建立联系。”

sentences.en: Christine Quinn,
sentences.zh: 克里斯汀·奎因，

sentences.en: Wynn's president, said her shelters set up informal centers where children of essential workers could do their remote learning while their parents worked.
sentences.zh: Wynn的总裁说，她的收容所设立了非正式中心，让必要工作人员的子女在父母工作时可以进行远程学习。

sentences.en: Overall, she said, the city's approach to homeless students during the pandemic has been, nothing but broken promises.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，她说，疫情期间城市对待无家可归学生的做法，除了破碎的承诺，什么都没有。

sentences.en: She noted that this summer, when many struggling students were to be enrolled in summer school, and when schools that serve children
sentences.zh: 她指出，今年夏天，当许多挣扎中的学生本应参加暑期学校，且服务于有

sentences.en: with severe disabilities have a six-week session, Department of Education iPads could not access the internet.
sentences.zh: 严重残疾儿童的学校有六周课程时，教育局的iPad却无法连接互联网。

sentences.en: A new login was required.
sentences.zh: 需要一个新的登录方式。

sentences.en: There was no coordination with DHS, she said, so none of us knew this was happening.
sentences.zh: 她说，由于与国土安全部（DHS）缺乏协调，我们谁都不知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: The staff was trying to figure out how to get students back online.
sentences.zh: 教职员工们正试图想办法让学生们重新上线学习。

sentences.en: The DOE said, we forgot to notify people about this change.
sentences.zh: 教育部表示，我们忘了通知大家这一变动。

sentences.en: They've been nothing but keystone cops as it relates to homeless kids doing virtual learning.
sentences.zh: 在涉及无家可归儿童进行在线学习的问题上，他们表现得简直就像一群笨手笨脚的滑稽警察。

sentences.en: The challenges that homeless students face with remote learning are one reason de Blasio has advocated a partial reopening of schools.
sentences.zh: 无家可归的学生在远程学习中面临的挑战，是白思豪主张学校部分重新开放的原因之一。

sentences.en: He said in a statement forwarded by a Department of Education spokeswoman, these kids were top of my mind the entire time our city was debating school reopening.
sentences.zh: 他在教育部发言人转发的一份声明中说，在我们城市讨论学校重新开放的整个过程中，这些孩子一直是我最挂念的。

sentences.en: We had to do it for them.
sentences.zh: 我们必须为他们这样做。

sentences.en: He continued, we can't operate out of a place of fear when it could mean everything for a child who has little to nothing.
sentences.zh: 他继续说道，当一个几乎一无所有的孩子可能失去一切时，我们不能在恐惧中行事。

sentences.en: That's the reality.
sentences.zh: 这就是现实。

sentences.en: We owe it to them to do better.
sentences.zh: 我们有责任为他们做得更好。

sentences.en: In August, roughly 30 organizations that work with homeless children and families
sentences.zh: 八月份，大约30个致力于帮助无家可归儿童和家庭的组织

sentences.en: wrote a letter urging de Blasio to offer in-person instruction to homeless children or give them access
sentences.zh: 联名写信敦促白思豪为无家可归的儿童提供面对面教学，或者让他们能够使用

sentences.en: to a space where they can get support with remote learning, as well as provide transportation.
sentences.zh: 一个可以获得远程学习支持的空间，并提供交通服务。

sentences.en: The letter noted that shelter rules prohibit leaving even older children in shelters during the day
sentences.zh: 信中指出，收容所的规定禁止在白天将即使是年龄较大的孩子留在收容所内

sentences.en: while parents work, and that more than half of families are placed in a shelter in a different borough from their youngest child's school.
sentences.zh: 而父母需要工作，而且超过一半的家庭被安置在与他们最小的孩子就读学校所在的行政区不同的收容所中。

sentences.en: At the end of August, Randy Levine, the policy director of Advocates for Children of New York, expressed disbelief about the lack of planning for homeless students.
sentences.zh: 八月底，纽约儿童权益倡导组织的政策主任兰迪·莱文对无家可归学生缺乏规划表示难以置信。

sentences.en: It's shocking how little is in place for students in shelter, she wrote in an email.
sentences.zh: 她在电子邮件中写道，令人震惊的是，为收容所里的学生提供的支持竟如此之少。

sentences.en: Many are starting the school year with no internet for remote learning, no bus to get to school, and no childcare for days when their parents are working.
sentences.zh: 许多孩子开始新学年时，没有远程学习所需的网络，没有校车去学校，父母工作时也没有人照看。

sentences.en: At a time when the city should be doing everything possible to support students in shelter, it is instead letting them fall even further behind.
sentences.zh: 在城市本应尽一切可能支持收容所学生的时候，它却让他们进一步落后了。

sentences.en: When my own son started kindergarten four years ago at our Brooklyn neighborhood public school,
sentences.zh: 四年前，当我自己的儿子在我们布鲁克林社区的公立学校上幼儿园时，

sentences.en: a solid city building where vines creep around the recess yard fence, it was a big beginning, a step into the wider world.
sentences.zh: 那是一栋坚固的城市建筑，藤蔓爬满了操场的围栏，这是一个伟大的开端，是他迈向广阔世界的一步。

sentences.en: He became a citizen of the city, shepherded by its crossing guards, fed its lunches, schooled in its many celebrations, the Chinese New Year, Easter, and Eid.
sentences.zh: 他成为了这个城市的公民，在过马路协管员的护送下，吃着学校的午餐，在学校举办的各种庆祝活动中学习，比如中国新年、复活节和开斋节。

sentences.en: He learned to pledge allegiance to our country, and four times a year, he was drilled in surviving a national sickness, school shooters.
sentences.zh: 他学会了向我们的国家宣誓效忠，并且每年四次，他都要进行应对国家顽疾——校园枪击案——的演习。

sentences.en: And he reported that he had made a best friend, Jay, a boy with bright eyes and a calm, easygoing demeanor who was, his teachers told us, incredibly sweet.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我他交到了一个最好的朋友，杰伊，一个有着明亮眼睛、性格冷静随和的男孩，老师告诉我们，他非常可爱。

sentences.en: Jay was repeating kindergarten because he had completed his first try while still struggling to read, and so he had a few adult teeth poking bunny style out of his smile.
sentences.zh: 杰伊因为在第一次尝试时读写困难，所以留级重读幼儿园，他的笑容里露出了几颗像兔子一样的恒牙。

sentences.en: My son, by contrast, was one of the youngest students in the class, an early reader, with what the parenting euphemizers call a spirited temperament.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，我儿子是班上年龄最小的学生之一，是个早慧的读者，有着家长们委婉称之为“活泼”的性格。

sentences.en: Sometimes, when he played with children who had similar dispositions, it got volatile.
sentences.zh: 有时，当他和性格相似的孩子一起玩时，场面会变得火爆。

sentences.en: Hands slammed under blocks, bitter tears over losing.
sentences.zh: 积木被摔在地上，因为输了而流下苦涩的泪水。

sentences.en: But with Jay, he found balance.
sentences.zh: 但和杰伊在一起时，他找到了平衡。

sentences.en: The two took care of each other.
sentences.zh: 他们俩互相照顾。

sentences.en: If my son got a better prize from a red supermarket machine, he would gladly give it to Jay.
sentences.zh: 如果我儿子从超市的红色扭蛋机里得到了更好的奖品，他会很乐意送给杰伊。

sentences.en: When I went with the boys and some friends to Legoland, my son came charging off a play structure, red in the face and crying, looking for me.
sentences.zh: 当我和孩子们还有一些朋友去乐高乐园时，我儿子满脸通红、哭着从游乐设施上冲下来找我。

sentences.en: Jay intercepted him, put an arm on each of his shoulders as if to steady him, and spoke a few words.
sentences.zh: 杰伊拦住他，把一只手搭在他的肩膀上，仿佛在安抚他，并说了几句话。

sentences.en: Then they ran off together.
sentences.zh: 然后他们一起跑开了。

sentences.en: Jay lived with his eight-year-old sister and his mother, May.
sentences.zh: 杰伊和八岁的姐姐以及母亲梅住在一起。

sentences.en: May asked that I use her middle name and her son's first initial to protect their privacy.
sentences.zh: 梅要求我使用她的中间名和她儿子的名字首字母，以保护他们的隐私。

sentences.en: On the top floor of a modest house opposite a cemetery, where some of Jay's great-grandparents are buried.
sentences.zh: 他们住在墓地对面一栋简朴房子的顶层，杰伊的一些曾祖父母就埋葬在那里。

sentences.en: His family is Hispanic and Italian.
sentences.zh: 他的家庭是西班牙裔和意大利裔。

sentences.en: Jay's mother moved into the small apartment after Jay's father left her when
sentences.zh: 杰伊的父亲在杰伊两岁时离开后，

sentences.en: Jay was two.
sentences.zh: 梅就搬进了这间小公寓。

sentences.en: The elderly woman who owned the building gave her the apartment rent-free in exchange for helping out with chores.
sentences.zh: 拥有这栋楼的老妇人免费把公寓租给她，作为交换，她帮忙做些家务。

sentences.en: May had dyslexia and crippling anxiety, which made it hard for her to take mass transit.
sentences.zh: 梅患有阅读障碍和严重的焦虑症，这使她很难乘坐公共交通工具。

sentences.en: But she was going to counseling and was also enrolled in a job training program.
sentences.zh: 但她一直在接受心理咨询，还参加了一个职业培训项目。

sentences.en: She got by on food stamps and public assistance and made her life work, cooking cornbread on a hot plate because her apartment's ancient stove didn't work.
sentences.zh: 她靠食品券和公共救济金勉强度日，努力生活，因为公寓里古老的炉子坏了，她就在电热板上做玉米面包。

sentences.en: She had raised five older children, who were in community college or working jobs around Brooklyn, and they helped out with Jay and his sister when they could.
sentences.zh: 她抚养了五个大孩子，他们有的在读社区大学，有的在布鲁克林各地工作，他们尽可能地帮着照顾杰伊和他的姐姐。

sentences.en: One of her older daughter's boyfriends took Jay to get haircuts in Sunset Park.
sentences.zh: 她大女儿的一个男朋友带杰伊去日落公园理发。

sentences.en: That daughter got the children winter coats.
sentences.zh: 那个女儿给孩子们买了冬天的外套。

sentences.en: May had spent the previous year going through the arduous process of getting her daughter,
sentences.zh: 梅在过去的一年里经历了艰苦的过程，才让她的女儿，

sentences.en: who is also dyslexic, placed in a private school for children with learning disabilities, where she was now thriving.
sentences.zh: 那个孩子也有阅读障碍，进入了一所为有学习障碍儿童开设的私立学校，现在她在那里成长得很好。

sentences.en: And in his second run of kindergarten, Jay was getting a lot of extra help and was reading well.
sentences.zh: 在第二次读幼儿园时，杰伊得到了很多额外的帮助，阅读能力也很好。

sentences.en: He was a popular kid, generous and kind and self-possessed.
sentences.zh: 他是个受欢迎的孩子，慷慨、善良且沉稳。

sentences.en: Jay's family's apartment faced a street that trucks rumble loudly through at all hours.
sentences.zh: 杰伊家公寓面对着一条街道，卡车在任何时候都会轰隆隆地驶过。

sentences.en: It was not a desirable place to live as recently as ten years ago, but as gentrification galloped through Brooklyn, it devoured that corner as well.
sentences.zh: 直到十年前，这里还不是一个理想的居住地，但随着中产阶级化在布鲁克林迅速蔓延，它也吞噬了那个街角。

sentences.en: New owners moved into a house down the block from Jay's a few years ago, painting the exterior a shade of charcoal.
sentences.zh: 几年前，新业主搬进了杰伊家那条街上的房子，把外墙漆成了炭灰色。

sentences.en: May said that developers then offered to buy her landlady's building.
sentences.zh: 梅说，开发商随后提出要购买她房东的楼房。

sentences.en: May received a notice of eviction before
sentences.zh: 在杰伊上一年级之前，

sentences.en: Jay's first grade year.
sentences.zh: 梅收到了驱逐通知。

sentences.en: She qualified for a housing voucher for $1,515.
sentences.zh: 她有资格获得1515美元的住房券。

sentences.en: She went through lists of landlords who supposedly accepted the vouchers and found numbers not in service and dead ends at every turn.
sentences.zh: 她查阅了据称接受住房券的房东名单，结果发现电话打不通，处处碰壁。

sentences.en: May worked with the office of a city councilman and a public interest lawyer to get a stay on her eviction to continue apartment hunting.
sentences.zh: 梅与一位市议员的办公室和一位公益律师合作，争取暂缓驱逐，以便继续寻找公寓。

sentences.en: She applied for affordable housing, which is awarded through a lottery, but she was not chosen.
sentences.zh: 她申请了通过抽签分配的经济适用房，但没有被选中。

sentences.en: She organized folders of documentation and paperwork so she could jump on any opportunity that came along.
sentences.zh: 她整理了文件和文书资料，以便能抓住任何可能出现的机会。

sentences.en: She stayed up nights crying and had to leave her job training program because dealing with her housing situation was a full-time job.
sentences.zh: 她彻夜哭泣，不得不放弃了职业培训项目，因为处理住房问题本身就是一份全职工作。

sentences.en: Eventually, May began moving things in plaid plastic zippered bags to the basement of one of her older children's jobs.
sentences.zh: 最终，梅开始用格子塑料拉链袋把东西搬到她大孩子工作的地方的地下室。

sentences.en: She called a local shelter every day for two weeks to see if she could be placed near her children's schools, but she says no one ever picked up the phone or returned her calls.
sentences.zh: 她连续两周每天都给当地的收容所打电话，看能否被安置在离孩子们学校近的地方，但她说从来没有人接电话或回电。

sentences.en: Jay cried when he had to give up his little gray dog because pets are not allowed in homeless shelters.
sentences.zh: 当杰伊不得不放弃他的小灰狗时，他哭了，因为无家可归收容所不允许养宠物。

sentences.en: He cried when his
sentences.zh: 当他的

sentences.en: PlayStation and train table got packed up.
sentences.zh: PlayStation游戏机和火车桌被打包带走时，他哭了。

sentences.en: At school pickup, he showed me toys he made out of paper and school supplies to take home to play with in his now empty room.
sentences.zh: 在学校接孩子时，他向我展示了他用纸和学校文具制作的玩具，带回家在他现在空荡荡的房间里玩。

sentences.en: On the day May was told the marshals would come and give her the final eviction notice, she kept the children home from school so they could go
sentences.zh: 在梅被告知法警会来送达最终驱逐通知的那天，她让孩子们待在家里没去上学，这样他们就可以

sentences.en: straight to the PATH intake center with the final notice.
sentences.zh: 带着最终通知直接去PATH收容中心。

sentences.en: May had Jay stay with a relative to avoid witnessing the formal eviction, but her daughter was too anxious to be away from her mother, so she stayed in the
sentences.zh: 梅让杰伊和亲戚待在一起，以免目睹正式的驱逐过程，但她的女儿太焦虑了，离不开母亲，所以她留在

sentences.en: apartment waiting, whistling at birds from her bedroom window, a favorite stuffed animal zipped into the front of her hoodie to take with her to PATH.
sentences.zh: 公寓里等待，从卧室窗户对着鸟儿吹口哨，她最喜欢的毛绒玩具塞在连帽衫的前兜里，准备带去PATH。

sentences.en: Although May had submitted medical documentation that she suffers from panic attacks on mass transit, the family was placed in conditional housing in a
sentences.zh: 尽管梅提交了医疗证明，说明她在乘坐公共交通工具时会惊恐发作，但该家庭还是被安置在布朗克斯区的一个

sentences.en: shelter in the Bronx, more than an hour by subway from both children's schools.
sentences.zh: 收容所里，距离两个孩子的学校乘地铁要一个多小时。

sentences.en: She would not be able to attend therapy, which was also back in Brooklyn.
sentences.zh: 她将无法参加治疗，因为治疗地点也在布鲁克林。

sentences.en: And May says she was told that the conditional status could take ten days or more, which she had not anticipated, and that during that time, the Department
sentences.zh: 梅说，她被告知这种临时状态可能需要十天或更长时间，这是她没预料到的，而且在此期间，教育部

sentences.en: of Education would not provide a school bus.
sentences.zh: 不会提供校车。

sentences.en: Ten days came and went.
sentences.zh: 十天过去了。

sentences.en: May said her daughter spent the first few days taking pictures of baby rats on glue traps in their living space in the shelter, marveling at their long snouts and tails.
sentences.zh: 梅说，她女儿头几天是在收容所的起居空间里给粘鼠板上的小老鼠拍照，惊叹于它们长长的鼻子和尾巴。

sentences.en: Then her school figured out a way to get a bus to the Bronx.
sentences.zh: 后来，她的学校想出了一个办法，安排了一辆校车去布朗克斯。

sentences.en: The ride took two and a half hours each way.
sentences.zh: 单程车程需要两个半小时。

sentences.en: But the Department of Education could not get a bus to take Jay back to our son's school until the family had an official shelter placement.
sentences.zh: 但教育部无法安排校车送杰伊回到我儿子的学校，直到该家庭获得正式的收容所安置。

sentences.en: So after two weeks without school, May reluctantly enrolled him in the local public school.
sentences.zh: 所以在缺课两周后，梅不情愿地让他入读了当地的公立学校。

sentences.en: She went to a store to get curtains to make the shelter living space more like a home.
sentences.zh: 她去商店买了窗帘，想让收容所的居住空间更像一个家。

sentences.en: When Jay's sister got sick with strep throat,
sentences.zh: 当杰伊的姐姐患上链球菌性咽喉炎时，

sentences.en: May discovered that her thermometer was packed in one of those plaid bags in Brooklyn.
sentences.zh: 梅发现她的体温计被打包在布鲁克林那些格子袋中的一个里了。

sentences.en: Her pediatrician was in Brooklyn, too, so they went to the emergency room.
sentences.zh: 她的儿科医生也在布鲁克林，所以他们去了急诊室。

sentences.en: The city called to say that it had found a potential apartment for the family, but May could not take her daughter to view the apartment.
sentences.zh: 市政府打电话说为他们家找到了一套潜在的公寓，但梅无法带女儿去看房。

sentences.en: She was vomiting violently at this point, and shelter rules prevented May from bringing anyone into the shelter to watch her.
sentences.zh: 此时她呕吐得厉害，而收容所的规定禁止梅带任何人进入收容所照顾她。

sentences.en: The family lost that opportunity.
sentences.zh: 这个家庭失去了那个机会。

sentences.en: At one point, after a fire alarm went off in the shelter and sent them out into the winter night unexpectedly, Jay began sleeping in his clothes.
sentences.zh: 有一次，收容所的火警响起，他们意外地被赶到了冬夜里，之后杰伊开始穿着衣服睡觉。

sentences.en: Ultimately, through her own connections, May found a tiny apartment on Staten Island where the landlord was willing to accept her voucher.
sentences.zh: 最终，通过她自己的人脉，梅在斯塔滕岛找到了一套小公寓，房东愿意接受她的住房券。

sentences.en: Jay cried when he learned he would be switching schools again and not coming back to our school.
sentences.zh: 当杰伊得知他又要转学，不能回到我们学校时，他哭了。

sentences.en: He fell far behind academically.
sentences.zh: 他的学业严重落后了。

sentences.en: The Staten Island apartment turned out to have black mold, May said, so the family moved again to another place in the borough, where a relative agreed to accept her voucher.
sentences.zh: 梅说，斯塔滕岛的公寓后来发现有黑霉菌，所以他们家又搬到了该行政区的另一个地方，那里的一位亲戚同意接受她的住房券。

sentences.en: Jay went to a new school again.
sentences.zh: 杰伊又去了一所新学校。

sentences.en: In August, May called me from their current home on Staten Island.
sentences.zh: 八月，梅从他们现在位于斯塔滕岛的家中给我打电话。

sentences.en: It was a nice neighborhood, she said, but hard for her to navigate.
sentences.zh: 她说那是一个不错的社区，但她很难适应。

sentences.en: Many of the children went to private Catholic school, and there was no laundromat or stores she could walk to.
sentences.zh: 许多孩子都去私立天主教学校，而且附近没有她能步行到达的自助洗衣店或商店。

sentences.en: She wasn't socializing in the new neighborhood and was panicking more.
sentences.zh: 她在新社区里没有社交，感到更加恐慌。

sentences.en: She still talked longingly about moving back to the neighborhood where she had many relatives within
sentences.zh: 她仍然渴望搬回那个社区，那里有许多亲戚在

sentences.en: 10 minutes, where she had grown up, and she talked about having Jay come back to our school.
sentences.zh: 10分钟路程内，那是她长大的地方，她还谈到让杰伊回到我们学校。

sentences.en: School was supposed to start in two weeks, but she hadn't heard much.
sentences.zh: 学校两周后就要开学了，但她还没听到什么消息。

sentences.en: Bus service hadn't been set up, and if there wasn't a bus, she had no way to get Jay to school.
sentences.zh: 校车服务还没安排好，如果没有校车，她就没法送杰伊上学。

sentences.en: Remote learning had not gone well.
sentences.zh: 远程学习进行得并不顺利。

sentences.en: Jay had no live teaching, and his speech therapist had sent May cards to print out.
sentences.zh: 杰伊没有直播教学，他的言语治疗师给梅寄来了可以打印的卡片。

sentences.en: She didn't have a printer, and her dyslexia made it hard to read many of the instructions that came with the assignments.
sentences.zh: 她没有打印机，而且她的阅读障碍使她很难读懂作业附带的许多说明。

sentences.en: We talked about trying to get the boys together, as we often did, and I felt a familiar pit of grief and guilt in my stomach.
sentences.zh: 我们谈到像往常一样试着让孩子们聚在一起，我感到胃里有一种熟悉的悲伤和内疚感。

sentences.en: From my son's perspective, on a random school day, his best friend vanished from school without notice or explanation.
sentences.zh: 从我儿子的角度来看，在一个普通的上学日，他最好的朋友在没有通知或解释的情况下从学校消失了。

sentences.en: The day before, Jay had apparently told a few children he was moving to California.
sentences.zh: 前一天，杰伊显然告诉几个孩子他要搬到加利福尼亚去了。

sentences.en: At the time, I wanted to protect Jay's face-saving story and actually didn't know what to tell my son about where his friend had gone.
sentences.zh: 当时，我想维护杰伊那个为了保全面子的故事，实际上我也不知道该怎么告诉儿子他的朋友去了哪里。

sentences.en: I didn't prepare him to lose his best friend because neither May nor I understood what the process would entail or how long it would take.
sentences.zh: 我没有让他做好失去最好朋友的准备，因为梅和我都不了解这个过程会涉及什么，或者需要多长时间。

sentences.en: I didn't know Jay wouldn't be allowed to have visitors at the shelter or spend a night at our house because of curfew.
sentences.zh: 我不知道因为宵禁，杰伊不能在收容所接待访客，也不能在我们家过夜。

sentences.en: My son missed Jay terribly for quite some time.
sentences.zh: 我儿子有很长一段时间非常想念杰伊。

sentences.en: He made other friends, but he never found a new best friend.
sentences.zh: 他交了其他朋友，但再也没有找到像杰伊那样最好的朋友。

sentences.en: School was an exposure to the wider world of our city in unanticipated ways, to the truth that there was no
sentences.zh: 学校以意想不到的方式让他接触到了我们城市的广阔世界，让他看到了一个真相：在那些崭新、低调的炭灰色房子中间，

sentences.en: place for a family that had lived in our neighborhood for generations amid the new, understated, charcoal gray houses.
sentences.zh: 没有一个地方能容纳一个已经在我们社区生活了几代人的家庭。

sentences.en: And that more broadly, the enormous wealth of the city would not insulate its vulnerable citizens, but rather accelerate their destabilization.
sentences.zh: 更广泛地说，这座城市巨大的财富不会保护其弱势公民，反而会加速他们的不稳定。

sentences.en: And that the adults involved, myself included, were seemingly powerless to help children no different from our own.
sentences.zh: 而参与其中的成年人，包括我自己，似乎都无力帮助那些与我们自己的孩子并无不同的孩子们。

sentences.zh: 这段录音由Autumn提供。

sentences.zh: Autumn是一款你可以下载的应用程序，可以收听来自《纽约时报》、《纽约客》、《名利场》和《大西洋月刊》等出版商的大量音频故事。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场残酷、混乱且有时令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.zh: 在《Metro》的最新一集中，和我一起，

sentences.en: Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 莎拉·凯尼格，讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.zh: 《Metro》。

sentences.zh: 在你获取播客的任何地方收听。
